title: Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries
title_zh: 计数动作，权衡声音：面向持续对抗者下校准多LLM委员会的贝叶斯辩证论证

paragraphs.en: A multi-LLM council lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated probability of being correct , and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing council aggregation methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than correctness, and they cannot identify or discount persistently unreliable agents. We introduce Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA), which treats the council’s typed moves—who proposed, challenged, or conceded which answer—as observations of a classical annotator model with per-agent reliabilities. This formulation recasts multi-agent deliberation as a reliability estimation problem, using the deliberation trace to infer agent reliability under persistent adversarial behavior. By weighting evidence according to inferred agent reliability, BDA yields calibrated posterior probabilities over candidate answers while allowing persistently unreliable agents to be inverted rather than merely outvoted. Across binary and multi-class benchmarks, BDA achieves the best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods, requiring no additional LLM calls, and improves robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions while remaining competitive in clean settings.
paragraphs.zh: 多LLM委员会让多个大型语言模型（LLM）对某个问题展开商议，并共同返回一个答案及其置信度估计。 随着这些系统在推理任务中的使用日益广泛，该置信度应代表经过校准的正确概率，且即便某些智能体持续不可靠，决策也应保持稳健。 现有的委员会聚合方法在这两方面均存在不足：其置信度估计衡量的是决断性而非正确性，且无法识别或降低持续不可靠智能体的影响。 我们提出了贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA）方法，它将委员会中各智能体的带类型动作——即谁提出、质疑或接受了哪个答案——视为对经典标注模型的观察，该模型为每个智能体分配了可靠性参数。 这种建模方式将多智能体商议重构为一个可靠性估计问题，利用商议过程留下的轨迹，在持续对抗性行为下推断各智能体的可靠性。 BDA通过根据推断出的智能体可靠性对证据进行加权，从而为候选答案生成经过校准的后验概率，同时允许持续不可靠的智能体被排除，而不仅仅是被多数票否决。 在二分类和多分类基准测试中，BDA在零成本委员会聚合方法中实现了最佳的校准效果，无需额外的LLM调用；它在持续对抗性联盟场景下提升了稳健性，同时在干净数据环境中仍保持竞争力。

paragraphs.en: Consider a panel of three large language models (LLMs) asked to verify a claim: they deliberate—proposing, challenging, conceding—and the system returns a verdict with a confidence. Two requirements make that verdict trustworthy: calibration —when the panel says “ 0.9 0.9 ” it should be right nine times in ten ( Dawid 1982 ) —and robustness : one persistently unreliable member, weak, stale, poorly prompted, or compromised, should not silently capture the answer. Fail the first and the confidence misleads; fail the second and the council is only as trustworthy as its worst seat.
paragraphs.zh: 设想一个由三个大型语言模型（LLM）组成的评审小组，它们被要求验证一项主张：这些模型会进行商议——提出观点、质疑对方、承认错误——最终系统会给出一个带有置信度的裁决。 要使这一裁决值得信赖，需要满足两个要求：校准性——当评审小组给出“0.9”时，其判断在十次中应有九次正确（Dawid 1982）；以及稳健性——即使存在一个持续不可靠的成员，无论其能力弱、观点陈旧、提示不当或受到干扰，都不应悄无声息地主导最终答案。 若校准性不达标，置信度就会产生误导；若稳健性不达标，整个评审小组的可靠性就仅取决于其中最薄弱的一环。

paragraphs.en: Deployed aggregators fail both requirements, each for a structural reason. Their confidences are decisiveness signals, not probabilities: a unanimous vote reports 1.0 1.0 , yet unanimous councils in our data are wrong 18 % 18\% of the time; an argumentation margin reports nearly 0 0 even when correct ( Smit and others 2024 ) . Every published aggregator we evaluate that emits a graded confidence has an expected calibration error (ECE) above 0.15 0.15 (the Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) family is exempt only because its scores are near-constant, not calibrated; ECE is defined formally in Appendix B). On robustness the failure is architectural: against a persistent member arguing persuasively for wrong answers, plurality collapses toward chance; MoA, which reads the members’ arguments, is captured through them—on one dataset fooled more than plain voting; and the methods that resist (Self-MoA; ArgLLMs) do so only by never consulting the council—robustness by abstention, which the fair attack of Section 7 collapses.
paragraphs.zh: 已部署的聚合器在两项要求上均未能满足，且每一项失败都有其结构性原因。 它们的置信度是决断性信号，而非概率：一致投票会报告 1.0 1.0，但我们数据中的一致委员会却有 18% 18\% 的错误率；而论证余量在正确时甚至报告接近 0 0（Smit 等人，2024）。 我们评估的所有已发表的、输出分级置信度的聚合器，其预期校准误差（ECE）均高于 0.15 0.15（混合智能体（MoA）系列之所以例外，仅因为其分数接近恒定而非经过校准；ECE 的正式定义见附录 B）。 在鲁棒性方面，失败源于架构设计：面对持续为错误答案进行有力论证的成员时，多数投票机制会向随机水平崩溃；而能够读取成员论证过程的 MoA 则会被这些成员所影响——在某一数据集上，它甚至比单纯投票更容易被误导；而那些具有抵抗能力的方案（Self-MoA、ArgLLMs）之所以有效，仅仅是因为它们从不咨询委员会——这种通过弃权实现的鲁棒性，在第 7 节的公平攻击中已被瓦解。

paragraphs.en: Both failures have one fix: treat the deliberation as evidence. This changes the role of deliberation in the aggregation pipeline: rather than treating the exchange primarily as prose to be judged or synthesized, we treat each protocol-governed move as an attributable probabilistic observation about the candidate answers. Councils emit typed moves — Propose , Challenge , Concede —whose legality a protocol governs, the speech acts of formal dialogue theory ( Hamblin 1970 ; Walton and Krabbe 1995 ) . We read each informative move by agent i i as a draw from a categorical noise model governed by that agent’s latent reliability θ i \theta_{i} , with a conjugate prior fitted on labeled calibration data, and apply Bayes’ rule— Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA). The posterior is closed-form (Eq. 2 ), costs no model calls, and meets both requirements: a probability whose conjugate prior doubles as a cross-validated recalibrator (Property 1 ), deciding by a weighted majority whose weights are the log-odds of each speaker’s reliability (Proposition 1 )—the committee rule of Nitzan and Paroush (1982) , plurality the equal-weight case.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种失败都有一个共同的解决方案：将审议过程视为证据。 这改变了审议在聚合流程中的角色：我们不再主要将交流视为需要评判或综合的文本，而是将每个受协议约束的行动视为对候选答案的可归因概率性观察。 委员会会发出带类型的行动——“提议”、“挑战”和“让步”——其合法性由协议规定，这些属于正式对话理论中的言语行为（Hamblin 1970；Walton and Krabbe 1995）。 我们将智能体 i 发出的每个信息性行动解读为从一个分类噪声模型中抽取的结果，该模型由该智能体的潜在可靠性 θ_i 控制，并使用带标签的校准数据拟合共轭先验，然后应用贝叶斯法则——即贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA）。 后验分布具有闭式解（公式 2），无需任何模型调用，且满足两个要求：其一，其共轭先验同时可作为交叉验证的重校准器（性质 1）；其二，通过加权多数法做出决策，权重为每位发言者可靠性的对数赔率（命题 1）——即 Nitzan 和 Paroush（1982）提出的委员会规则，其中多数投票是等权重的特例。

paragraphs.en: When a persistent adversary’s fitted reliability falls below chance, its weight becomes negative and its endorsements become evidence for the opposite answer—BDA does not out-argue a persuasive adversary, it learns not to believe that seat; the council’s signal without its attack surface (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 当一个持续对抗者的拟合可靠性降至低于随机水平时，其权重变为负值，其背书则成为支持相反答案的证据——BDA 并不会在论证上击败一个具有说服力的对抗者，而是学会不再相信该席位；此时，信号仅来自委员会本身，而不包含其攻击面（图1）。

paragraphs.en: Model: deliberation as reliability-weighted evidence. We introduce a signed endorsement semantics that maps protocol-governed typed moves to attributable observations over candidate answers, reframing deliberation as reliability-weighted inference over candidate answers using the classical annotator model of Dawid and Skene (1979) . The formulation extends to K > 2 K>2 through a tempered composite likelihood and per-agent confusion matrices.
paragraphs.zh: 模型：将审议视为可靠性加权的证据。 我们引入一种带符号的确认语义，它将协议管理的类型化动作映射到候选答案上的可归因观察，从而将审议重新表述为基于 Dawid 和 Skene（1979）经典标注者模型对候选答案进行可靠性加权推理的过程。 该公式通过调和复合似然和每个智能体的混淆矩阵，可扩展至 K > 2 的情况。

paragraphs.en: Theory. The most-probable answer is a log-odds weighted majority in which sub-chance seats weigh negatively , Bayes-optimal at K = 2 K{=}2 (Proposition 1 ). Five properties scope the model: calibration holds exactly when the model matches the data (Property 1 ); the binary posterior ceiling and the symmetric-prior collapse are K = 2 K{=}2 artifacts that dissolve for K > 2 K{>}2 (Property 2 ); self-reported confidences cannot move the posterior (Property 3 ); prior influence washes out at the per-agent rate O ⁡ ( λ / N i ) O(\lambda/N_{i}) (Property 4 ); and the defense needs the unreliability identifiable—in the calibration window, stationary, seat-stable (Property 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 理论。 最可能的答案是采用对数赔率加权多数投票，其中次概率席位具有负权重，在 K = 2 时达到贝叶斯最优（命题 1）。 五个属性界定了该模型：校准仅在模型与数据完全匹配时成立（属性 1）；二元后验上限和对称先验坍缩是 K = 2 时的产物，当 K > 2 时会消失（属性 2）；自我报告的置信度无法改变后验分布（属性 3）；先验的影响以每个智能体的速率 O(λ/N_i) 逐渐减弱（属性 4）；并且防御机制需要不可靠性具有可识别性——在校准窗口内、处于稳态且席位稳定（属性 5）。

paragraphs.en: MoA ( Wang and others 2025 ) , Self-MoA ( Li and others 2026 ) , and multi-agent debate ( Khan and others 2024 ) aggregate deliberation through different mechanisms, while prior work has exposed fragile gains, poorly calibrated confidence, conformity effects, and the importance of the full interaction trajectory ( Smit and others 2024 ; Cui and Du 2025 ; Hao and others 2026 ; Cui and others 2026 ) . We use the MoA family and plurality as baselines (Section 5 ) and address the remaining gap with a calibrated per-seat interpretation of deliberation under persistent adversaries.
paragraphs.zh: MoA（Wang 等人，2025）、Self-MoA（Li 等人，2026）以及多智能体辩论（Khan 等人，2024）通过不同机制整合审议过程，而先前的研究已揭示了这些方法中脆弱的收益、校准不佳的信心水平、从众效应，以及完整互动轨迹的重要性（Smit 等人，2024；Cui 和 Du，2025；Hao 等人，2026；Cui 等人，2026）。 我们将 MoA 系列方法和多数投票法作为基线（第 5 节），并通过在持续对抗者环境下对审议进行按席位校准的解释，来解决剩余的差距。

paragraphs.en: A quantitative bipolar argumentation framework scores arguments and propagates their strengths through attack and support edges ( Dung 1995 ; Baroni et al. 2019 ) . The argumentative-LLM pipeline (ArgLLMs) of Freedman and others (2025) has one model generate and score an argument tree for a claim and returns the tree’s gradual strength as its confidence. We evaluate ArgLLMs as the strongest published claim-verification baseline: its strength-as-confidence is a margin, not a probability, and LLM argument mining and judging are themselves unreliable ( Sanayei and others 2025 ) —exactly why BDA reads typed moves rather than prose: public, verifiable communication semantics, the classical agent-communication principle ( Singh 1998 ; Wooldridge 2000 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一种定量双极性论证框架会对论点进行评分，并通过攻击与支持边传播其强度（Dung 1995；Baroni 等，2019）。 Freedman 等人（2025）提出的论证-LLM 流程（ArgLLMs）中，一个模型会生成并评分某一主张的论证树，并将该树的渐进强度作为其置信度返回。 我们将 ArgLLMs 评估为目前发表的最强的主张验证基线方法：其“强度即置信度”是一个余量而非概率，而 LLM 的论点挖掘与判断本身并不可靠（Sanayei 等，2025）——这正是 BDA 读取输入文本中的行动步骤而非散文的原因：公开且可验证的通信语义，即经典的智能体通信原则（Singh 1998；Wooldridge 2000）。

paragraphs.en: Weighting votes by competence is classical—the optimal rule for independent binary voters uses log-reliability-odds ( Nitzan and Paroush 1982 ; Grofman et al. 1983 ) , generalizing Condorcet’s jury theorem. BDA is this lineage on a new carrier: protocol-governed typed moves, per-agent priors fitted from data, a K K -candidate treatment, and an adversarial evaluation (concurrent work attacks LLM debate empirically Amayuelas and others 2024 ; Khan and others 2024 ; Cui and Du 2025 ; we add the aggregation defense). We measure calibration ( Dawid 1982 ) by ECE ( Guo and others 2017 ) and the proper Brier ( Brier 1950 ) , comparing against post-hoc recalibration ( Zadrozny and Elkan 2002 ) —a comparison that changes our own clean headline (Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 按能力对投票进行加权是一种经典方法——对于独立的二元投票者，最优规则采用对数可靠性赔率（Nitzan 和 Paroush 1982；Grofman 等 1983），从而推广了孔多塞的陪审团定理。 BDA 是这一谱系在新载体上的延续：遵循协议的类型化操作、基于数据拟合的每个智能体的先验分布、对 K 个候选人的处理，以及对抗性评估（同期研究通过实证攻击 LLM 辩论 Amayuelas 等 2024；Khan 等 2024；Cui 和 Du 2025；我们增加了聚合防御）。 我们通过 ECE（Guo 等 2017）和适当的布雷尔评分（Brier 1950）来衡量校准性（Dawid 1982），并与事后重新校准（Zadrozny 和 Elkan 2002）进行比较——这一比较改变了我们最初得出的简洁结论（第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Inferring a hidden truth from noisy annotators is a long crowdsourcing literature: the one-coin model of Dawid and Skene (1979) fits one reliability per annotator by expectation–maximization (EM); Raykar and others (2010) learn per-class confusion matrices; Raykar and Yu (2012) down-weight and invert adversarial annotators exactly as our negative weights do; and a parallel line estimates reliabilities without labels ( Whitehill et al. 2009 ; Zhang and others 2016 ; Hovy and others 2013 ; Ratner and others 2020 ) . BDA is this annotator model on a new carrier—typed deliberation moves under a protocol, per-agent reliabilities and, in our generalization, full confusion matrices—stress-tested against a live adversarial coalition rather than independent noise, where the unsupervised estimator’s label-switching ambiguity is exactly what a supervised prior resolves (Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 从存在噪声的标注者中推断隐藏真相，是众包领域一个长期存在的研究课题：Dawid 和 Skene（1979）提出的“单硬币模型”通过期望最大化（EM）算法为每位标注者拟合一个可靠性参数；Raykar 等人（2010）学习了每类的混淆矩阵；Raykar 和 Yu（2012）对对抗性标注者进行降权并精确反转其权重，这与我们使用的负权重方法完全一致；此外，另一条研究路线则无需标签即可估计可靠性（Whitehill 等人，2009；Zhang 等人，2016；Hovy 等人，2013；Ratner 等人，2020）。 BDA 是将上述标注者模型应用于一种新的载体——即遵循特定协议的类型化审议步骤、每位智能体的可靠性参数以及在我们提出的扩展方法中完整的混淆矩阵——并通过一个真实的对抗性联盟对其进行压力测试，而非仅针对独立噪声；在此过程中，无监督估计器所存在的标签切换歧义，恰好是监督先验能够解决的问题（第 7 节）。

paragraphs.en: The name of the method summarizes it. We count moves : the record reduces to who endorsed which answer, prose discarded. We weigh voices : each agent’s counts enter the posterior through its own fitted reliability—an adversarial voice, we will see, weighs negatively . The central modeling choice is this reduction from deliberative traces to signed endorsements. It defines how protocol-governed dialogue acts become attributable probabilistic observations over candidate answers; once this representation is fixed, inference follows from the classical annotator model of Dawid and Skene (1979) . One precision: at K = 2 K{=}2 rounds are nearly irrelevant to the final decision (net 17 17 of 4,500 4{,}500 ; Appendix E), so the binary carrier is in effect weighted round- 0 0 voting; the dialectics there earns its keep in the reliability estimator ( ECE em \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{em}} → 0.080 0.117\!\to\!0.080 ), its contribution to the final decision grows with K K (fix/break → 1.61 1.10\!\to\!1.61 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该方法的名称已概括了其核心内容。 我们统计行动次数：记录简化为哪些智能体支持了哪些答案，其余文本则被舍弃。 我们对不同声音进行权衡：每个智能体的计票结果会通过其自身拟合的可靠性进入后验分布——正如我们将看到的，对抗性声音的权重为负。 核心建模选择在于将审议痕迹简化为带符号的支持声明。 它定义了受协议约束的对话行为如何转化为对候选答案的可归因概率观察；一旦这种表示方式确定，推理过程便可依据 Dawid 和 Skene（1979）的经典标注者模型完成。 需要指出的一点是：当 K = 2 时，各轮次对最终决策的影响几乎可以忽略不计（净影响为 4,500 中的 17；参见附录 E），因此这种二元载体实际上相当于零轮投票；其中的辩证逻辑在可靠性估计器中发挥了关键作用（ECEem → 0.080），其对最终决策的贡献则随 K 的增大而增强（固定/破坏 → 1.61）。

paragraphs.en: A deliberation trace T = ( m 1 , … , m N ) T=(m_{1},\dots,m_{N}) is an ordered sequence of N N typed moves. Each move carries a force , the identity of the agent that made it (agents are indexed i = 1 , … , I i=1,\dots,I ; here I = 3 I{=}3 ), a round index, and—depending on the force—an answer and a target move. The move algebra has five forces; the dialogue-game protocol ( Prakken 2005 ) used in all our experiments emits three ( Propose , Challenge , Concede ; Appendix D). We write 𝒦 = { c 1 , … , c K } \mathcal{K}=\{c_{1},\dots,c_{K}\} for the K K candidate answers, g g for a candidate under consideration, g ⋆ ∈ 𝒦 g^{\star}\in\mathcal{K} for the unknown correct answer (the datasets’ gold label), and π 0 \pi_{0} for a prior over candidates (uniform in every experiment).
paragraphs.zh: 一个审议轨迹 T = ( m 1 , … , m N ) T=(m_{1},\dots,m_{N}) 是一个由 N 个带类型的移动组成的有序序列。 每个移动都携带一种力量、执行该移动的智能体的身份（智能体通过 i = 1 , … , I i=1,\dots,I 索引；此处 I = 3 I{=}3 ）、一个回合索引，以及——取决于该力量——一个答案和一个目标移动。 移动代数包含五种力量；我们所有实验中使用的对话游戏协议（Prakken 2005）会产生三种力量（Propose、Challenge、Concede；见附录 D）。 我们用 𝒦 = { c 1 , … , c K } \mathcal{K}=\{c_{1},\dots,c_{K}\} 表示 K 个候选答案，用 g g 表示正在考虑的候选答案，用 g ⋆ ∈ 𝒦 g^{\star}\in\mathcal{K} 表示未知的正确答案（数据集的黄金标签），并用 π 0 \pi_{0} 表示候选答案的先验分布（在所有实验中均为均匀分布）。

paragraphs.en: Each move reduces to a signed endorsement . This abstraction is intentionally minimal: aggregation depends on who publicly supported or opposed which candidate, not on how that support was linguistically expressed. A Propose endorses its own answer; a Concede to another agent’s proposal endorses that proposal’s answer; a Challenge rejects its target’s answer; self-concedes and abstentions carry no information. The extractor reads only the force, the agent, the target, and the answer—never the move’s free-text surface , never its self-reported confidence. Discarding the surface is deliberate (judging argument text is exactly the attackable step we set out to avoid); discarding the confidence gives Property 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 每次行动都简化为一次带符号的背书。 这种抽象是有意保持极简的：聚合取决于谁公开支持或反对了哪个候选人，而非这种支持在语言上如何表达。 “提出”会背书自己的答案；“向另一个智能体的提议让步”会背书该提议的答案；“挑战”会拒绝其目标的答案；自我让步和弃权则不包含任何信息。 提取器仅读取行动的力度、执行者、目标和答案——绝不读取行动的自由文本表层，也绝不读取其自我报告的置信度。 丢弃表层是有意为之（判断论证文本正是我们试图避免的可攻击步骤）；丢弃置信度则满足了性质3。

paragraphs.en: Five properties say why the model behaves as it does and where it stops; statements, proofs, and numerical verification are in Appendix C.
paragraphs.zh: 五个特性说明了模型为何如此表现以及其作用的边界；相关陈述、证明和数值验证见附录C。

paragraphs.en: If the prior and likelihood match the data-generating process, the BDA confidence is calibrated in Dawid’s sense.
paragraphs.zh: 如果先验和似然与数据生成过程相匹配，那么贝叶斯决策分析的置信度在达维德的意义上是经过校准的。

paragraphs.en: In plain words: a posterior is the one kind of number that can be calibrated, and the CV-selected prior is what earns it—a one-parameter recalibrator, not a theorem’s gift. The qualifier binds harder for the confusion model: with challenges at K > 2 K{>}2 , Eq. ( 4 ) is a composite likelihood even at τ = 1 \tau{=}1 , with a plug-in Dirichlet mean, so its calibration is a cross-validated correction, never “by construction” (Appendix C).
paragraphs.zh: 用通俗的话说：后验是一种可以校准的数，而通过交叉验证选出的先验正是赋予它这种能力的因素——它是一个单参数再校准器，而非定理所赠予的产物。 对于混淆模型而言，这一限定条件更具约束力：当 K > 2 K{>}2 时存在挑战，见公式 (4)。 即使 τ = 1 \tau{=}1 ，公式 (4) 仍是一个复合似然，其中包含一个插值狄利克雷均值，因此其校准是一种通过交叉验证进行的修正，绝非“由构造决定”（附录 C）。

Both are artifacts of the Beta-function symmetry at K = 2 K{=}2 ; for K > 2 K{>}2 the ( K − 1 ) − ( N i − e i ​ ( g ) ) (K{-}1)^{-(N_{i}-e_{i}(g))} factor of Eq. ( 1 ) makes the log-odds grow without bound, so the posterior learns even under a symmetric prior.
paragraphs.zh: 当 K = 2 时，每个智能体共享一个真实可靠性 θ ⋆ ∈ ( 1 2 , 1 )，且 θ i 在 CV 选择的方程 (3) 中的有限强度先验下被整合时，关于 g ⋆ 的后验分布会收敛到一个严格低于 1 的上限；而在对称先验（ α 0 = β 0 ）的情况下，后验分布甚至完全不会偏离先验。这两种现象都是 K = 2 时 Beta 函数对称性所导致的结果；对于 K > 2 的情况，方程 (1) 中的因子 ( K − 1 ) − ( N i − e i ​ ( g ) ) 会使对数赔率无限增长，因此即使在对称先验下，后验分布也能进行学习。

paragraphs.en: In plain words: binary BDA is honestly humble and a symmetric prior is a trap; for K > 2 K{>}2 the same growth makes the one-coin over-confident, and the confusion model’s temperature absorbs it (the clean- K > 2 K{>}2 fix, Section 6 ). The ceiling is a property of our finite-strength construction, not of binary aggregation—a hierarchical, growing-strength θ i \theta_{i} posterior would pin the orientation; we keep the CV-selected s s because it is the recalibrator (Appendix C).
paragraphs.zh: 用通俗的话说：二元 BDA 是诚实而谦逊的，而对称先验则是一种陷阱；对于 K > 2 K{>}2 的情况，同样的增长会使单硬币模型变得过度自信，而混淆模型的“温度”会吸收这种过度自信（即针对 K > 2 K{>}2 的修正方案，见第 6 节）。 这个上限是我们有限强度构造的特性，而非二元聚合的特性——一个分层且强度递增的 θ i \theta_{i} 后验分布会固定方向；我们保留通过交叉验证选定的 s s，因为它是重新校准器（见附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: The posterior is invariant, bit for bit, to any rewriting of the per-move self-reported confidences.
paragraphs.zh: 后验分布对于每一步移动中自我报告的置信度的任何重写都是逐比特不变的。

paragraphs.en: Sycophantic confidence inflation ( Fanous and others 2025 ) cannot move BDA: permuting every confidence across all 4,500 4{,}500 traces changes no posterior by a bit; an adversary who changes what the moves endorse is Section 7 ’s subject.
paragraphs.zh: 谄媚式的置信度膨胀（Fanous 等人，2025）无法影响 BDA：在所有 4,500 个轨迹中置换每个置信度都不会使后验概率发生丝毫变化；而一个改变智能体所支持行动的对手，则是第 7 节的主题。

paragraphs.en: The posterior is Lipschitz in the prior parameters. At the uniform-error K = 2 K{=}2 ceiling the Lipschitz constant does not vanish as evidence grows; for the confusion model at K > 2 K{>}2 the Dirichlet prior instead washes out at the per-agent rate O ⁡ ( λ / N i ) O(\lambda/N_{i}) , dominating only in the sparse regime.
paragraphs.zh: 后验分布相对于先验参数是利普希茨连续的。 在均匀误差 K = 2 的上限下，随着证据增加，利普希茨常数不会消失；而对于 K > 2 的混淆模型，狄利克雷先验反而以每个智能体的速率 O(λ/N_i) 趋于零，仅在稀疏区域中占主导地位。

sents.en: The posterior is Lipschitz in the prior parameters.
sents.zh: 后验分布相对于先验参数是利普希茨连续的。

sents.en: At the uniform-error K = 2 K{=}2 ceiling the Lipschitz constant does not vanish as evidence grows; for the confusion model at K > 2 K{>}2 the Dirichlet prior instead washes out at the per-agent rate O ⁡ ( λ / N i ) O(\lambda/N_{i}) , dominating only in the sparse regime.
sents.zh: 在均匀误差 K = 2 的上限下，随着证据增加，利普希茨常数不会消失；而对于 K > 2 的混淆模型，狄利克雷先验反而以每个智能体的速率 O(λ/N_i) 趋于零，仅在稀疏区域中占主导地位。

paragraphs.en: A misspecified prior is damped, not always forgotten: not at the K = 2 K{=}2 ceiling (refit across task families), while the confusion’s washes out—predicting that at light contamination, where the off-diagonal is under-determined, the fewer-parameter one-coin recovers faster (Property 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 设定不当的先验会被削弱，但并非总是被遗忘：在 K = 2 的上限（跨任务族重新拟合）时并非如此，而混淆效应则会逐渐消失——预测表明，在轻微污染的情况下，当非对角元素处于欠确定状态时，参数较少的单硬币模型能更快地恢复（性质 5）。

paragraphs.en: Reliability weighting requires the unreliability to be identifiable : present in the labeled calibration window, stationary into deployment, and attached to a stable seat.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠性加权要求不可靠性可以被识别：存在于已标记的校准窗口中，在部署时保持稳定，并附着于一个稳定的基座。

paragraphs.en: Rotation defeats per-seat identification (the confusion’s absolute rows still recover a strong rotating coalition); a sleeper —clean during calibration, hostile after—inherits our trust until re-fitting catches it; we measure both boundaries (Appendix F).
paragraphs.zh: 轮转破坏了按席位识别的方法（混淆的绝对行仍然能够恢复一个强大的轮转联盟）；潜伏智能体——在校准期间表现正常，之后则变得敌对——会一直继承我们的信任，直到重新拟合将其识别出来；我们对这两个边界都进行了测量（附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: We use three binary claim-verification datasets (MedClaim, StrategyClaim, TruthfulClaim; the ArgLLMs evaluation family of Freedman and others 2025 ), n = 500 n{=}500 each; PubMedQA ( K = 3 K{=}3 ; yes/no/maybe) ( Jin and others 2019 ) , class-balanced n = 300 n{=}300 ; and a four-way subset of MMLU ( Hendrycks and others 2021 ) , n = 500 n{=}500 . Each dataset is generated under three seeds (proposers at temperature 0.7 0.7 , the MoA convention): the binary pool is 4,500 4{,}500 trials; results are seed means, with paired bootstrap for head-to-head tests (dispersion in the appendix).

paragraphs.en: We select baselines to span the principal methodological alternatives to BDA rather than variants of one approach: direct vote aggregation (plurality majority); deliberation-based aggregation (MoA and MoA-Lite ( Wang and others 2025 ) , which synthesize the proposer surfaces ; Self-MoA ( Li and others 2026 ) , six samples of one model; ArgLLMs ( Freedman and others 2025 ) , which verifies each of the task’s own candidates (fn. 1), never reading the council); supervised discriminative aggregation ( logistic stacking , an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} regression on the same per-seat tallies c i ​ ( g ) , d i ​ ( g ) c_{i}(g),d_{i}(g) BDA reads, and a gated vote , plurality restricted to seats whose calibration accuracy clears chance); and latent reliability estimation (unsupervised Dawid–Skene EM , one-coin EM on the deployment pool with no labels). BDA enters as shared, per-agent, and confusion. One asymmetry favors the baselines: their evaluator/synthesizer runs on a stronger model ( gpt-4.1-mini ) than any council seat; the MoA-family confidences are near-constant (calibration N/A).
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择的基线方法涵盖了BDA的主要方法论替代方案，而非单一方法的变体：直接投票聚合（多数票）；基于审议的聚合（MoA和MoA-Lite（Wang等，2025），该方法综合了提案者表面；Self-MoA（Li等，2026），一个模型的六个样本；ArgLLMs（Freedman等，2025），该方法验证任务本身的每个候选者（注1），但从不阅读委员会）；监督判别聚合（逻辑回归堆叠，对相同的每席位计票c_i(g)、d_i(g)进行ℓ₂回归，这些是BDA所读取的数据，以及一个门控投票，仅针对校准精度超过偶然水平的席位进行多数票限制）；以及潜在可靠性估计（无监督的Dawid–Skene EM，在没有标签的情况下对部署池进行单硬币EM）。 BDA作为共享的、每个智能体特定的以及混淆因素被引入。 一种不对称性有利于这些基线方法：它们的评估器/综合器运行在比任何委员会席位都更强的模型（gpt-4.1-mini）上；MoA系列的置信度接近恒定（校准不适用）。

All supervised aggregators’ hyperparameters are chosen by nested, leak-free CV on the same label budget—outer folds produce the reported numbers, inner folds select the hyperparameters, no test label influences a choice that scores it—on the proper Brier score (ECE selection is degenerate; Appendix D). Free-text K > 2 K{>}2 answers are scored by a candidate-restricted extractor with a single frozen LLM judge for prose-only commitments; parse rates and the judge ledger are in Appendix D.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了准确率；在十个等宽和十五个等质量分箱下的 ECE（ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}}、ECE em \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{em}}；附录 B）；布雷尔分数；以及一个 10,000 10{,}000 次重采样配对自助法，该方法提供了置信区间和 p win p_{\mathrm{win}}。 所有监督聚合器的超参数均通过嵌套且无数据泄露的交叉验证，在相同的标签预算中选择——外层折产生所报告的数值，内层折选择超参数，没有任何测试标签会影响对其评分的选择——基于标准的布雷尔分数（ECE 的选择是退化的；附录 D）。 自由文本形式的 K > 2 K{>}2 答案由一个候选受限的提取器进行评分，该提取器使用单个冻结的 LLM 裁判专门评估纯文本承诺；解析率和裁判账目见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 holds three clean-data findings—one against us, reported with equal prominence.
paragraphs.zh: 表2包含三项关于干净数据的发现——其中一项对我们不利，但同样得到了同等程度的报道。

paragraphs.en: BDA per-agent reaches ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 0.016 0.016 against majority’s 0.160 0.160 (the confusion posts the best Brier), at no marginal cost and no recalibration step—the cross-validated conjugate prior is the recalibrator (Appendix E). And weighing voices changes which answer wins : per-agent BDA beats plurality by 1.71 1.71 points in every paired resample, a gain a monotone recalibration of a fixed decision cannot touch.
paragraphs.zh: BDA 每个智能体在对抗多数派时，其 ECE 的 ew 值（即 \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}}）为 0.016 0.016，而多数派的 ECE 值为 0.160 0.160（混淆矩阵给出了最佳的 Brier 得分），且无需任何边际成本或重新校准步骤——经过交叉验证的共轭先验本身即是重新校准器（附录 E）。 此外，对各方观点进行权衡会改变最终获胜的答案：在每个配对的重采样中，每个智能体的 BDA 方法都比多数派投票法高出 1.71 1.71 分，这种提升是固定决策的单调重新校准所无法实现的。

paragraphs.en: Granting the baselines the same label budget, leak-free isotonic recalibration ( Zadrozny and Elkan 2002 ) collapses everyone’s calibration error, and a recalibrated ArgLLMs then leads on Brier atop its accuracy lead. On clean data BDA is not the best aggregator money can buy—it is the best it need not buy: the only free arm with a decision gain and no recalibration stage. The case rests on what happens next.
paragraphs.zh: 在基线模型获得相同标签预算的情况下，无泄漏的等温再校准（Zadrozny 和 Elkan，2002）使所有模型的校准误差趋于一致，而经过再校准的 ArgLLMs 则凭借其在准确率上的领先优势，在 Brier 评分上更进一步。 在干净数据上，BDA 并非市面上最出色的聚合方法——它恰恰是无需购买的最佳选择：这是唯一无需付费、具备决策增益且没有再校准阶段的方案。 这一论断的关键在于接下来会发生什么。

paragraphs.en: On PubMedQA and MMLU the one-coin BDA is badly over-confident—the same ( K − 1 ) (K{-}1) factor that enables K > 2 K{>}2 learning (Property 2 ) concentrates the posterior, to ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 0.30 0.30 and 0.18 0.18 against plurality’s 0.26 0.26 and 0.09 0.09 . The tempered confusion model repairs it ( 0.072 0.072 and 0.063 0.063 , accuracy within a point, zero cost)—and what repairs it is the temperature: a one-coin with a single CV temperature already recovers the calibration ( 0.051 0.051 / 0.037 0.037 , matching the full model), because a seat’s several moves per task are correlated and counting them as independent over-counts the evidence; CV accordingly drives λ \lambda high on clean K > 2 K{>}2 , shrinking the learned matrix toward the one-coin (Appendix E). The confusion matrix is held in reserve: it earns its place under attack (Section 7 ), where a coalition’s systematic errors are what a full confusion, not a scalar reliability, can invert. Read faithfully, ArgLLMs never reads the council; its clean K > 2 K{>}2 accuracy trails (the † rows of Table 1 ; Appendix E). Deliberation’s net value rises with K K (fix/break ratios 1.10 1.10 , 1.20 1.20 , 1.61 1.61 ; Appendix E).
paragraphs.zh: 在 PubMedQA 和 MMLU 上，单硬币 BDA 表现出严重的过度自信——正是这一（ K − 1 ）（K{-}1）倍因子使得 K > 2 K{>}2 的学习成为可能（属性 2），它使后验分布集中，导致 ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 分别为 0.30 和 0.18，而多数投票法则为 0.26 和 0.09。 经过调节的混淆模型修复了这一问题（0.072 和 0.063，准确率误差在一点以内，成本为零）——而实现修复的关键在于温度：仅使用单一 CV 温度的单硬币模型即可恢复校准效果（0.051 / 0.037，与完整模型一致），因为一个智能体在每项任务中的多次行动是相关的，将其视为独立事件会高估证据；因此，CV 会在干净的 K > 2 K{>}2 情况下将 λ \lambda 推至较高水平，使学习到的矩阵向单硬币模型收缩（附录 E）。 混淆矩阵被保留备用：它在攻击情境下（第 7 节）才发挥其作用，因为联盟的系统性错误正是完整混淆模型（而非标量可靠性）能够逆转的关键。 若严格解读，ArgLLMs 从未读取委员会的信息；其干净的 K > 2 K{>}2 准确率低于预期（见表 1 的 † 行；附录 E）。 深思熟虑的净价值随 K K 增大而上升（修复/破坏比率分别为 1.10、1.20、1.61；附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: We model k k bad seats of three (a stale checkpoint, poisoned fine-tune, or manipulated prompt) in two temporal flavors: a persistent adversary on the same seats every task, including the calibration folds—the realistic, validation-exposable case—and a rotating one on fresh random seats each task. The count-level attack flips a corrupted endorsement with probability p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} (the dose–response of Appendix F); the live attack makes the adversarial seats real language models under a stealth role—argue against the truth, pick the most defensible wrong answer, concede to allies, blend in—compliance-measured at 87 87 – 100 % 100\% anti-correct proposals. The full protocol is in Appendix F and the prompts in Appendix I; the four evaluation pitfalls we caught and fixed, in Appendix D.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将三种类型的 k 个不良座位（过时的检查点、被污染的微调或经过操纵的提示）建模为两种时间模式：一种是在每次任务中持续作用于相同座位的持久性对抗者，包括校准折——这是现实且可暴露于验证的情况；另一种则是在每次任务中作用于新的随机座位的轮转式对抗者。 计数级攻击以概率 p_wrong（附录 F 中的剂量-反应关系）翻转一个被污染的认可；实时攻击则使对抗性座位成为具有隐形角色的真实语言模型——反驳真相、选择最可辩护的错误答案、向盟友让步、融入其中——其合规性通过 87%–100% 的反正确提案进行衡量。 完整协议见附录 F，提示见附录 I；我们在附录 D 中发现了并修正了四个评估陷阱。

paragraphs.en: A synthetic adversary of tunable strength p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} isolates the inversion mechanism: under persistence BDA per-agent rises with p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} , to 0.923 0.923 / 0.915 0.915 at p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 (above its clean 0.751 0.751 ) while majority decays to 0.163 0.163 ; rotation is Property 5 ’s regime.
paragraphs.zh: 一个强度可调的合成对抗者 p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} 隔离了反转机制：在持续存在的情况下，每个智能体的 BDA 随着 p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} 的增加而上升，在 p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 时达到 0.923 0.923 / 0.915 0.915（高于其干净状态下的 0.751 0.751），而多数派则下降至 0.163 0.163；旋转属于属性 5 的机制范围。

paragraphs.en: The live adversary’s arguments are expert-quality, and they contaminate the genuine members : honest seats flip under coordinated challenges, a contagion channel no count-level model can express (Appendix G). The learned confusion earns its keep, and a permutation control identifies the mechanism (Appendix F): it leads every PubMedQA cell and binary k = 2 k{=}2 , ahead of the one-coin by 16 16 and 37 37 points ( → 0.892 0.734\!\to\!0.892 , → 0.840 0.471\!\to\!0.840 ): a coalition’s errors are systematic and the fitted confusion inverts them—a gain that survives per-task label permutation. Its margin over the stacker on PubMedQA is exactly the label-identity component permutation destroys; MMLU’s positional options carry none, which is why the label-indifferent stacker leads there. Same evidence, budget, folds, randomized tie-breaking (Appendix D). Under the seed-clustered bootstrap the split holds on binary k = 2 k{=}2 ( + 0.027 +0.027 , CI [ + 0.021 , + 0.034 ] [+0.021,+0.034] ) and PubMedQA k = 2 k{=}2 ( + 0.087 +0.087 , CI [ + 0.052 , + 0.121 ] [+0.052,+0.121] ); the k = 1 k{=}1 cells are ties. Every supervised council-reading arm crushes majority; the shared prior collapses hardest ( 0.038 0.038 , PubMedQA k = 2 k{=}2 )—Bayesian machinery without per-seat resolution follows the corrupted majority, the cleanest evidence that per-agent structure defends. MoA, judging argument content anew each task, is captured through it, trailing plain voting on PubMedQA. BDA never judges arguments, only track records—and the robustness is not the deliberation’s: on round- 0 0 -truncated traces the same pipelines are more accurate under attack ( 0.933 0.933 vs 0.736 0.736 , one-coin binary k = 2 k{=}2 )—rounds import contagion. The defense is round- 0 0 weighting, the classical vote of Proposition 1 ; the trace earns its keep in the estimator, the calibration, and clean K > 2 K{>}2 (Appendix F).
paragraphs.zh: 实时对手提出的论点具有专家级质量，并且会污染真实成员：在协同挑战下，诚实的席位会发生翻转，这是一种任何计数级模型都无法表达的传染通道（附录 G）。 这种学习到的混淆确实有其价值，一种排列控制方法识别出了其机制（附录 F）：它使每个 PubMedQA 单元格和二元 k = 2 k{=}2 的情况都比单硬币模型领先 16 分和 37 分（→ 0.892 0.734\!\to\!0.892 , → 0.840 0.471\!\to\!0.840 ）：联盟的错误是系统性的，而拟合的混淆则能将其逆转——这种优势在每项任务的标签排列变化下依然成立。 它在 PubMedQA 上相对于堆叠模型的优势，恰好是标签身份成分被破坏时消失的部分；MMLU 的位置选项不包含任何此类成分，因此对标签无感的堆叠模型在该任务中表现更优。 证据、预算、折分以及随机化平局处理均相同（附录 D）。 在种子聚类自助法下，该结果在二元 k = 2 k{=}2 的情况下成立（+ 0.027 +0.027 , CI [ + 0.021 , + 0.034 ] [+0.021,+0.034] ），并在 PubMedQA k = 2 k{=}2 的情况下也成立（+ 0.087 +0.087 , CI [ + 0.052 , + 0.121 ] [+0.052,+0.121] ）；k = 1 k{=}1 的单元格则为平局。 每个受监督的委员会阅读分支都碾压了多数派；共享先验的崩溃最为严重（0.038 0.038 , PubMedQA k = 2 k{=}2 ）——缺乏席位级分辨率的贝叶斯机制会跟随被污染的多数派，这是最清晰的证据，表明每个智能体的结构具有防御性。 MoA 在每项任务中都会重新判断论点内容，因此其表现可通过此方法捕捉到，并在 PubMedQA 上落后于简单的投票方法。 BDA 从不判断论点本身，仅关注历史记录——而这种鲁棒性并非来自审议过程：在零轮截断的记录中，相同的流程在攻击下反而更准确（0.933 0.933 vs 0.736 0.736 , 单硬币二元 k = 2 k{=}2 ）——回合顺序对传染效应有影响。 这种防御机制基于零轮加权，即命题 1 中的经典投票；该记录在估计器、校准过程以及干净的 K > 2 K{>}2 情况下均证明了其价值（附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: The invariance of Self-MoA and ArgLLMs in Table 1 is abstention, not robustness: Figure 2 mounts the same anti-correct adversary inside each method’s own pipeline—Self-MoA collapses, ArgLLMs erodes with the answer space, the council holds near clean. The ordering (no internal check < < evaluator cross-check < < redundancy with reliability learning) is architectural: only reliability weighting tolerates a corrupted minority .
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 中 Self-MoA 和 ArgLLMs 的不变性表现为弃权，而非鲁棒性：图 2 将相同的反正确对抗智能体嵌入每种方法自身的流程中——Self-MoA 会崩溃，ArgLLMs 会随着答案空间而退化，而委员会则几乎保持纯净。 这种排序（无内部检查 < < 评估器交叉验证 < < 与可靠性学习相关的冗余）是架构性的：只有可靠性加权能够容忍少数被破坏的智能体。

BDA’s prior base b > 1 2 b{>}\tfrac{1}{2} (Eq. 3 ) fixes the sign the data cannot.

paragraphs.en: Given the same labels, leak-free isotonic recalibration erases BDA’s calibration edge (recalibrated majority: ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 0.006 0.006 ) but not its accuracy—majority still collapses under the coalition ( 0.37 0.37 , binary k = 2 k{=}2 ); the durable edges are accuracy under attack and zero cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在给定相同标签的情况下，无泄漏的等渗重新校准消除了 BDA 的校准优势（重新校准后的多数类：ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 0.006 0.006），但并未影响其准确性——多数类在联盟攻击下仍然失效（0.37 0.37，二元 k = 2 k{=}2）；持久的优势在于攻击下的准确性和零成本。

paragraphs.en: Coalition challenges flip genuine seats, so the effective corrupted fraction exceeds the nominal ( 0.68 0.68 / 0.72 0.72 vs 2 / 3 2/3 at k = 2 k{=}2 ): the survival results face harder evidence than the seat count implies. Weak ( r = 0.68 r{=}0.68 ) and near-chance ( r = 0.55 r{=}0.55 ) swap-in seats degrade gracefully, the confusion still leading and calibrated.
paragraphs.zh: 联盟挑战翻转了真实席位，因此实际被腐蚀的比例超过了名义比例（在 k = 2 时，0.68 / 0.72 对比 2/3）：生存结果所面临的证据比席位数量所暗示的更为严峻。 较弱的（r = 0.68）和接近随机水平的（r = 0.55）替换席位能够平稳退化，但混淆现象仍然存在且经过校准。

paragraphs.en: The best-calibrated zero-cost confidence, a decision gain recalibration cannot produce, and leading accuracy under a persistent adversary on two of three domains. Claims we do not make: clean accuracy dominance (recalibrated ArgLLMs wins, at a price); positional- K > 2 K{>}2 under attack (stacking); post-recalibration calibration dominance (recalibrated majority); unconditional robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 在三个领域中两个领域内，经过最佳校准的零成本置信度是决策收益重新校准无法实现的，并且在持续对抗下能带来更高的准确性。 我们并未做出以下主张：干净准确率上的优势（重新校准后的 ArgLLMs 虽能获胜，但需付出代价）；攻击下的位置性 K > 2 K{>}2（堆叠）；重新校准后的校准优势（重新校准后的多数派）；无条件鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Ship the confusion model where answer labels carry stable cross-task identity, re-fitting periodically: it matches the one-coin clean, dominates every zero-cost arm under validation-exposed attack, and is calibrated under fire; positional options pass its edge to the stacker, open answer spaces to the one-coin. Its two exposures—light sleeper contamination and a between-fit policy shift—are measurably announced by row drift (twice the noise floor at a fifth of a window; Appendix F); the policy-robust fallback is the one-coin .
paragraphs.zh: 部署这种混淆模型：其中答案标签具有稳定的跨任务身份，并定期重新拟合；它能与“单硬币”干净模型相匹配，在验证暴露攻击下优于所有零成本臂，并在高压环境下保持校准；位置选项将其优势传递给堆叠器，而开放答案空间则传递给“单硬币”。 其两种暴露——浅睡眠污染与拟合间的策略偏移——可通过行漂移被明显检测到（噪声底层的两倍，窗口大小的五分之一；附录 F）；策略稳健的备用方案是“单硬币”。

sents.en: Ship the confusion model where answer labels carry stable cross-task identity, re-fitting periodically: it matches the one-coin clean, dominates every zero-cost arm under validation-exposed attack, and is calibrated under fire; positional options pass its edge to the stacker, open answer spaces to the one-coin.
sents.zh: 部署这种混淆模型：其中答案标签具有稳定的跨任务身份，并定期重新拟合；它能与“单硬币”干净模型相匹配，在验证暴露攻击下优于所有零成本臂，并在高压环境下保持校准；位置选项将其优势传递给堆叠器，而开放答案空间则传递给“单硬币”。

sents.en: Its two exposures—light sleeper contamination and a between-fit policy shift—are measurably announced by row drift (twice the noise floor at a fifth of a window; Appendix F); the policy-robust fallback is the one-coin .
sents.zh: 其两种暴露——浅睡眠污染与拟合间的策略偏移——可通过行漂移被明显检测到（噪声底层的两倍，窗口大小的五分之一；附录 F）；策略稳健的备用方案是“单硬币”。

paragraphs.en: Although evaluated on multi-LLM councils, BDA is not tied to that architecture. The formulation applies to repeated multi-agent decision processes that expose protocol-typed, agent-attributed commitments over a shared candidate space and permit agent reliability to be estimated across tasks. The council setting is one instantiation of this broader inference problem.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 BDA 是在多 LLM 委员会上进行评估的，但它并不局限于该架构。 这一公式适用于重复的多智能体决策过程，这些过程在共享候选空间上暴露具有协议类型和智能体属性的承诺，并允许跨任务估计智能体的可靠性。 委员会设置是这一更广泛推理问题的一个具体实例。

paragraphs.en: Supervision. BDA consumes labeled calibration data ( ≈ 25 \approx 25 labels, amortized; baselines get the same budget); label-free settings exclude it. Persistence. The adversary must misbehave in the calibration window and keep misbehaving; a sleeper inherits our trust—a narrow exposure (a fifth of a window recovers it; Appendix F), mitigated by re-fitting. The confusion and the stacker need strictly more: the error structure must persist, and a policy shift costs both their entire edge (Appendix F). Identifiability. Moderate-dose rotation defeats every trace-reading arm. Heterogeneity. Near-homogeneous reliabilities reduce the per-agent model to a noisier shared BDA (Appendix H). Model. Move independence is an idealization the temperature absorbs; abstention is untested.
paragraphs.zh: 监督。 BDA 消耗带标签的校准数据（≈25 个标签，摊销后；基线模型获得相同预算）；无标签设置则不包含此项。持久性。 对抗方必须在校准窗口期间表现异常并持续如此；潜伏者会继承我们的信任——这种暴露时间很短（窗口的五分之一即可恢复信任；附录 F），而重新拟合可以缓解这一问题。 混淆和堆叠器需要严格更多的资源：错误结构必须持续存在，而策略转变会使其完全失去优势（附录 F）。可识别性。 中等剂量的轮转能够击败所有痕迹读取分支。异质性。 接近同质的可靠性会将每个智能体的模型简化为一个噪声更大的共享 BDA（附录 H）。模型。 移动独立性是一种理想化假设，温度因素会吸收这种影响；弃权尚未得到验证。

paragraphs.en: A council’s deliberation record, interpreted as agent-attributed probabilistic evidence over candidate answers, becomes a problem of joint inference over answer correctness and per-agent reliability. BDA realizes this formulation through the classical annotator model of Dawid and Skene (1979) ; with its confusion refinement, it provides what current aggregators lack: a probability calibrated as the answer set grows and a decision that learns to discount, even invert, an unreliable voice. Open are aggregation-aware adversaries (policy shift and rotation bound them), online re-fitting, hierarchical and semi-supervised estimation, and—the trace being typed —temporal-logic verification of the deliberation itself. Pay a small, amortized supervision cost to know whom to believe.
paragraphs.zh: 将委员会的审议记录解释为针对候选答案的智能体属性概率性证据，这一问题便转化为对答案正确性与各智能体可靠性的联合推理问题。 BDA 通过 Dawid 和 Skene（1979）的经典标注者模型实现了这一表述；借助其混淆细化机制，它提供了当前聚合器所缺乏的能力：随着答案集扩大而校准的概率，以及一种能够学习对不可靠声音进行折扣甚至反转的决策机制。 待探索的方向包括：感知聚合过程的对抗性因素（策略偏移和旋转对其构成约束）、在线重新拟合、层次化与半监督估计，以及——鉴于该轨迹具有类型属性——对审议过程本身的时序逻辑验证。 只需支付一笔小额的摊销监督成本，即可明确应当信任谁。

paragraphs.en: This appendix supports the main paper and is meant to be read on its own. Appendix A fixes notation and expands every acronym. Appendix B is a self-contained probability primer, the aggregation algorithm, and a one-by-one roster of every method we evaluate. Appendix C gives the formal statements, their proofs, and their numerical verification. Appendix D documents methodology—including the four evaluation pitfalls we found and fixed—implementation, and reproducibility. Appendix E collects the full clean-data results and ablations; Appendix F the adversarial study end to end, with its robustness follow-ups (recalibration, label switching, permutation, policy shift, row-drift monitoring, contagion). Appendix G reproduces qualitative traces and works one example through the arithmetic. Appendix H covers the small-council study. Appendix I reproduces every prompt verbatim, and Appendix J is the provenance ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录为主论文提供支持，也可独立阅读。 附录 A 统一了符号表示，并解释了所有缩写词。 附录 B 是一个独立的概率学基础篇，包含聚合算法以及我们所评估的每种方法的一一列表。 附录 C 给出了形式化陈述、其证明以及数值验证结果。 附录 D 记录了研究方法——包括我们发现并修正的四个评估陷阱——实现细节及可重复性。 附录 E 汇总了完整干净数据下的结果与消融分析；附录 F 则完整呈现了对抗性研究，并附上了其鲁棒性后续分析（重新校准、标签切换、排列、策略偏移、行漂移监控、传播效应）。 附录 G 复现了定性追踪过程，并对一个示例进行了完整的算术演算。 附录 H 涵盖了小委员会研究部分。 附录 I 逐字复现了所有提示语，附录 J 则是其来源记录表。

paragraphs.en: The Brier score 1 n ​ ∑ t = 1 n ( p ^ t − y t ) 2 \frac{1}{n}\sum_{t=1}^{n}(\hat{p}_{t}-y_{t})^{2} ( Brier 1950 ) —a mean squared error over the n n samples t = 1 , … , n t{=}1,\dots,n , each with confidence p ^ t \hat{p}_{t} and label y t ∈ { 0 , 1 } y_{t}\in\{0,1\} —is proper (uniquely minimized, in expectation, by reporting the true probability), and Murphy’s decomposition writes it as reliability minus resolution plus uncertainty ( Murphy 1973 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 布里尔分数 1 n ​ ∑ t = 1 n ( p ^ t − y t ) 2 \frac{1}{n}\sum_{t=1}^{n}(\hat{p}_{t}-y_{t})^{2}（布里尔，1950）——即对 n n 个样本 t = 1 , … , n t{=}1,\dots,n 计算的平均平方误差，每个样本的置信度为 p ^ t \hat{p}_{t}，标签为 y t ∈ { 0 , 1 } y_{t}\in\{0,1\}——是一个适当的评分规则（从期望值的角度来看，通过报告真实概率可唯一最小化），而墨菲的分解将其表示为可靠性减去分辨率再加上不确定性（墨菲，1973）。

paragraphs.en: The one quantity ρ \rho does not equalize is the fraction γ Φ \gamma_{\Phi} of a method’s evidence it corrupts. For the readers γ = 2 / 3 \gamma{=}2/3 and a clean seat survives; for Self-MoA γ = 1 \gamma{=}1 , because its “ensemble” is six draws of one model, so compromising the model corrupts every sample; for ArgLLMs the whole generated tree. This is forced by architecture—a single-pipeline method has no redundant channel—and it is exactly the property under study, so a bare “Self-MoA collapses, BDA survives” would conflate redundancy with reliability weighting. We separate the two by holding both fixed: MoA is also a three-model reader, attacked at the same γ = 2 / 3 \gamma{=}2/3 and also keeping one clean seat, yet it falls from 0.72 0.72 to 0.48 0.48 because its synthesizer trusts the persuasive arguments, while BDA holds ( 0.75 0.75 to 0.73 0.73 ). The BDA − - MoA gap at identical architecture and identical budget is the reliability-weighting effect with the fraction asymmetry removed ; the single-pipeline collapses are the separate, architectural point.

paragraphs.en: (i) For MoA, ArgLLMs, and Self-MoA the aggregation stage is itself an LLM—a synthesizer, a strength evaluator—and ρ \rho leaves it clean , touching only the proposers, generator, or samples. This is generous to those baselines: it grants them an uncompromised internal check, which is precisely why ArgLLMs degrades rather than collapsing. BDA needs no such grant, its Agg \mathrm{Agg} being the closed-form posterior, with no LLM to compromise. (ii) On K > 2 K{>}2 the ArgLLMs attack is gold-routed: it uses g ⋆ g^{\star} to undermine the correct option and bolster each wrong one, a per-option-optimal attack stronger than the commit-to-one council adversary (both are gold-aware; the optimization is not). This cuts against ArgLLMs, and we flag it so the K > 2 K{>}2 comparison is read with the asymmetry in view.
paragraphs.zh: (i) 对于 MoA、ArgLLMs 和 Self-MoA，聚合阶段本身就是一个 LLM——一个合成器、一个强度评估器——而 ρ \rho 保持其纯净，仅与提议者、生成器或样本接触。 这对那些基线模型来说相当宽容：它赋予它们一个不受妥协的内部检查机制，而这正是 ArgLLMs 会退化而非崩溃的原因。 BDA 不需要这样的宽容，因为它的 Agg \mathrm{Agg} 是闭式后验分布，不存在可能被妥协的 LLM。 (ii) 在 K > 2 K{>}2 的情况下，ArgLLMs 的攻击是“黄金路由”的：它使用 g ⋆ g^{\star} 来破坏正确选项并增强每个错误选项，这是一种针对每个选项都最优的攻击，比“承诺单一选择”的委员会对抗者更强（两者都了解黄金标准；但优化过程并不了解）。 这一点不利于 ArgLLMs，我们在此指出，以便在比较 K > 2 K{>}2 时能考虑到这种不对称性。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 2 (c) is a statement about the deployed finite-strength Beta-marginal construction: the calibration data enter only through the prior mean μ i \mu_{i} of main Eq. (3), while the strength s s stays a CV-selected constant, so within a single trace the model can still re-interpret an agent as reliable under one truth hypothesis and anti-reliable under the swap—which is what caps the posterior. A hierarchical alternative, a global θ i \theta_{i} posterior whose effective strength grows with every labeled calibration move, pins the orientation as labels accumulate and removes the ceiling. We keep the finite CV-selected s s deliberately: it is the one-parameter recalibrator of Theorem 1 ’s qualifier, chosen on held-out Brier precisely because grown-strength posteriors are over-confident under the misspecifications the temperature also absorbs (Appendix C.5 ); the hierarchical variant is future work. This supervised ceiling is distinct from the unsupervised K = 2 K{=}2 label-switching symmetry of Appendix F.10 , which no amount of unlabeled data can break.
paragraphs.zh: 定理 2 (c) 是一个关于已部署的有限强度 Beta-边际构造的陈述：校准数据仅通过主方程中的先验均值 μ i \mu_{i} 输入。 (3)，而强度 s s 保持为 CV 选择的常数，因此在单个轨迹中，模型仍可能在一个真值假设下将智能体重新解释为可靠的，而在交换假设下则将其解释为不可靠的——这正是后验概率的上限所在。 一种分层替代方案是一个全局的 θ i \theta_{i} 后验分布，其有效强度随着每个带标签的校准步骤而增长；随着标签的积累，该方案会固定方向并消除上限。 我们有意保留有限的、由 CV 选择的 s s：它是定理 1 限定条件中的单参数重新校准器，在预留的 Brier 数据上选择它，正是因为在温度参数也吸收的误设条件下，强度增长的后验分布会过度自信（附录 C.5）；分层变体是未来的工作。 这种监督式上限与附录 F.10 中无监督的 K = 2 K{=}2 标签切换对称性不同，后者无论使用多少无标签数据都无法打破。

paragraphs.en: We use the composite form rather than the censored one for two reasons. It preserves the Dirichlet-count conjugacy and the count space shared with main Eqs. (1)–(3), so the fitting stage is one tally in both regimes; and the over-count it introduces is of the same character as the within-round move correlation—both inflate the effective evidence—which is what the cross-validated temperature is observed to absorb (the tempered one-coin control of Appendix E.5 ). Two clarifications the reframing makes exact: the candidate posterior is a normalized distribution over 𝒦 \mathcal{K} by construction (the normalization in Eq. (4)); what is not normalized is the move-level generative story. And the Dirichlet mean is a plug-in, not a marginalization, so the score is a regularized point-estimate pseudo-posterior rather than a marginal likelihood.
paragraphs.zh: 我们出于两个原因使用复合形式而非审查后的形式。首先，它保留了狄利克雷计数的共轭性以及与主方程 (1)–(3) 共享的计数空间，因此拟合阶段在两种机制下都只需一次统计；其次，它引入的过度计数与回合内移动的相关性具有相同的性质——两者都会放大有效证据——而交叉验证温度恰好吸收了这一点（参见附录 E.5 中的缓和单硬币控制）。这种重新表述使两个问题变得明确：根据构造，候选后验分布是 𝒦 \mathcal{K} 上的一个归一化分布（方程 (4) 中的归一化）；未归一化的部分是移动层面的生成故事。此外，狄利克雷均值是一种直接代入法，而非边缘化，因此得分是一个正则化的点估计伪后验，而非边缘似然。

paragraphs.en: Three consequences. (i) Decision rule. The MAP of main Eq. (4) is the additive committee arg ⁡ max g ​ [ log ⁡ π 0 ​ ( g ) + τ ​ ∑ i ∑ g ′ c i ​ ( g ′ ) ​ log ⁡ P i ​ ( g ′ ∣ g ) ] \arg\max_{g}[\log\pi_{0}(g)+\tau\sum_{i}\sum_{g^{\prime}}c_{i}(g^{\prime})\log P_{i}(g^{\prime}\mid g)] , whose g g -vs- h h log-odds is the count-weighted sum τ ​ ∑ i ∑ g ′ c i ​ ( g ′ ) ​ log ⁡ P i ​ ( g ′ ∣ g ) P i ​ ( g ′ ∣ h ) \tau\sum_{i}\sum_{g^{\prime}}c_{i}(g^{\prime})\log\frac{P_{i}(g^{\prime}\mid g)}{P_{i}(g^{\prime}\mid h)} of per-agent log-likelihood ratios—the multiclass Nitzan–Paroush committee. Proposition 2 is its binary, single-endorsement, uniform-error projection, and Bayes-optimality is established only there; the inversion mechanism nonetheless carries over, since an adversary whose fitted confusion places mass off the diagonal turns its endorsements into evidence for rivals. (ii) Calibration. By Lemma 3 the joint is a composite likelihood whenever a challenge appears at K > 2 K{>}2 —even at τ = 1 \tau{=}1 —and at τ < 1 \tau{<}1 it is additionally tempered; the plug-in Dirichlet mean ignores parameter uncertainty. Theorem 1 therefore applies only in the lemma’s exactness regime, and the calibration we report for K > 2 K{>}2 is cross-validated (via τ \tau on held-out Brier), not implied. The violated idealization is conditional independence of moves given the answer (concedes correlate with their targets); the temperature absorbs it empirically, a Markov round model being the principled alternative. (iii) Prior sensitivity. With τ = 1 \tau{=}1 the Dirichlet prior enters the log-posterior additively and its influence decays at the per-agent rate O ⁡ ( λ / N i ) O(\lambda/N_{i}) , so—unlike the K = 2 K{=}2 ceiling of Theorem 4 —prior sensitivity vanishes with evidence, and λ \lambda dominates only in the sparse regime (the bias–variance trade-off of the sleeper sweep, Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 三个后果。（i）决策规则。主方程的 MAP。 （4）是加性委员会的 arg ⁡ max g ​ [ log ⁡ π 0 ​ ( g ) + τ ​ ∑ i ∑ g ′ c i ​ ( g ′ ) ​ log ⁡ P i ​ ( g ′ ∣ g ) ] \arg\max_{g}[\log\pi_{0}(g)+\tau\sum_{i}\sum_{g^{\prime}}c_{i}(g^{\prime})\log P_{i}(g^{\prime}\mid g)]，其 g 与 h 的对数赔率是各智能体的对数似然比的计数加权总和 τ ​ ∑ i ∑ g ′ c i ​ ( g ′ ) ​ log ⁡ P i ​ ( g ′ ∣ g ) P i ​ ( g ′ ∣ h ) \tau\sum_{i}\sum_{g^{\prime}}c_{i}(g^{\prime})\log\frac{P_{i}(g^{\prime}\mid g)}{P_{i}(g^{\prime}\mid h)}——即多类 Nitzan–Paroush 委员会。 命题 2 是其二元、单一认可、均匀误差的投影，且仅在该命题中确立了贝叶斯最优性；然而，其反转机制仍然适用，因为一个拟合混淆矩阵将质量置于对角线之外的对手，会将其认可转化为对竞争对手的证据。（ii）校准。 根据引理 3，当挑战出现在 K > 2 K{>}2 时——即使在 τ = 1 \tau{=}1 的情况下——联合分布都是一个复合似然；而在 τ < 1 \tau{<}1 时，它还会受到进一步调整；插值狄利克雷均值忽略了参数不确定性。 因此，定理 1 仅适用于该引理的精确性范围，而我们对 K > 2 K{>}2 所报告的校准结果是通过交叉验证（利用保留集上的 Brier 得分对 τ 进行验证）得出的，而非直接推导出的。 被违反的理想化假设是：在给定答案的情况下，各行动步骤具有条件独立性（承认这一点意味着它们与目标相关）；温度参数在经验上吸收了这一影响，而马尔可夫回合模型则是更合乎原则的替代方案。（iii）先验敏感性。 当 τ = 1 \tau{=}1 时，狄利克雷先验以加性方式进入对数后验分布，其影响以各智能体的速率 O ⁡ ( λ / N i ) O(\lambda/N_{i}) 衰减；因此——与定理 4 中 K = 2 K{=}2 的上限不同——先验敏感性会随证据增加而消失，且 λ 仅在稀疏数据情况下占主导地位（即“沉睡横扫”中的偏差-方差权衡，见附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: This section explains model selection in plain terms, documents four ways an evaluation of this kind can fool itself, and records the implementation, storage, and cost ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 本节以通俗易懂的语言解释了模型选择，记录了此类评估可能自我欺骗的四种方式，并记载了实现、存储和成本账目。

paragraphs.en: Every BDA hyperparameter is chosen by nested cross-validation, and the two nesting levels do different jobs. The outer level splits the data into five folds stratified by the gold label; each outer fold is held out in turn, and the numbers we report are computed only on these held-out rows. The inner level operates entirely within an outer fold’s training part: it runs its own five-fold split to choose ( b , κ , s ) (b,\kappa,s) for the per-agent model, or ( μ , s ) (\mu,s) for the shared model (the κ = 0 \kappa{=}0 slice), by the Brier score. Because the inner level never sees the outer held-out rows, no test label ever influences a choice that later scores it. The reliabilities r i r_{i} are re-fitted on each outer training part alone. The per-agent grid is b ∈ { 0.52 , 0.55 , 0.58 , 0.60 } b\in\{0.52,0.55,0.58,0.60\} , κ ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } \kappa\in\{0,1,2,3,4\} , s ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } s\in\{4,8,16,32\} .
paragraphs.zh: 每个 BDA 超参数都通过嵌套交叉验证进行选择，且两个嵌套层级承担不同的任务。 外层将数据按真实标签分层划分为五个折；每个外层折依次被保留，我们报告的数值仅基于这些保留的行计算得出。 内层完全在一个外层折的训练部分内部运行：它执行自己的五折划分，通过 Brier 评分为每个智能体的模型选择 ( b , κ , s )（b,\kappa,s），或为共享模型（即 κ = 0 \kappa{=}0 的部分）选择 ( μ , s )（\mu,s）。 由于内层从未看到外层保留的行，因此没有任何测试标签会影响后续对其评分的选择。 可靠性 r i r_{i} 仅在每个外层训练部分上重新拟合。 每个智能体的参数网格为 b ∈ { 0.52 , 0.55 , 0.58 , 0.60 } b\in\{0.52,0.55,0.58,0.60\}，κ ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } \kappa\in\{0,1,2,3,4\}，s ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } s\in\{4,8,16,32\}。

paragraphs.en: On a class-balanced binary task the constant forecast p ^ ≡ 0.5 \hat{p}\equiv 0.5 has an expected calibration error of 0 0 : minimizing ECE is satisfied by refusing to say anything. An ECE-selected grid duly chooses the degenerate symmetric prior—the collapse of Property 2—precisely because that collapse produces a constant 0.5 0.5 confidence. The Brier score is proper: it penalizes the lack of resolution and avoids the trap. We flag this because ECE-selected calibration methods are common and inherit the pathology; the grid also excludes b = 0.50 b{=}0.50 , the collapse boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个类别平衡的二元任务中，恒定预测值 p ^ ≡ 0.5 \hat{p}\equiv 0.5 的期望校准误差为 0 0 ：通过拒绝做出任何预测即可满足最小化 ECE 的要求。 ECE 选择的网格恰当地选择了退化的对称先验——即属性 2 的坍缩——正是由于这种坍缩产生了恒定的 0.5 0.5 置信度。 布里尔评分是合适的：它对缺乏分辨率的情况进行惩罚，并避免了这一陷阱。 我们指出这一点，因为 ECE 选择的校准方法很常见且继承了这种病理问题；该网格也排除了 b = 0.50 b{=}0.50 ，即坍缩边界。

The full tables carry the standard deviation across seeds.

paragraphs.en: The free-text baselines (the MoA family, and—before the faithful multi-option fix below—ArgLLMs) emit verbose answers on the K > 2 K{>}2 tasks. The common “last capital letter” heuristic is correct for a terse answer (“The answer is C.”) but reads the final prose letter of a long justification, and it scored all three baselines below the 0.25 0.25 chance floor on four-way MMLU—a parsing artifact, not model failure. We re-extract every stored answer with a candidate-restricted parser (a bolded letter, then “answer is X X ”, then a leading “ X X .”, then the first standalone candidate; for word labels, the first word-boundary candidate). A residual of MMLU answers commit to an option only in prose : “the authority to coin money” names the option “Coining money” without ever writing its letter. Scoring these as wrong understates the baseline, so we pass exactly this residual to one frozen LLM judge ( gpt-4.1-nano , temperature 0 0 ), which reads the option texts and the answer and returns the committed letter or NONE ; genuine non-commitments (empty answers, refusals, off-topic text) return NONE and stay wrong. Every judge verdict is cached, so the scoring is reproducible from the raw answers at no cost. On clean MMLU the judge maps 65 65 of MoA’s 227 227 unmapped answers to a committed option, raising its accuracy from 0.605 0.605 to 0.640 0.640 ; the other 162 162 are genuine non-commitments and stay wrong. Parse rates are disclosed with every table (Table 5 ); sub-chance baseline accuracy is a useful tripwire, and we recommend it as a standard check.

paragraphs.en: Freedman and others (2025) , footnote 1, extends claim verification to multiple-option questions by “generating a set of candidate answers and applying our method to each of these.” The candidate answers are the question’s own options; ArgLLMs generates its argument tree for each and never consults an external council. Feeding ArgLLMs the council’s proposer surfaces as its candidate set instead produces two artifacts. It returns a proposer paragraph as the answer (the parse problem above), and it made ArgLLMs appear attackable on K > 2 K{>}2 , because corrupting the proposals corrupted its candidate set. The faithful implementation—verify the task’s own options—restores 100 % 100\% parse and makes ArgLLMs council-invariant on every K K , exactly as it already was on binary. Its clean K > 2 K{>}2 accuracy changes in both directions: PubMedQA rises from an understated 0.369 0.369 to 0.516 0.516 , and MMLU falls from an overstated 0.682 0.682 to 0.565 0.565 (it had been borrowing signal from the council’s proposals). We report the faithful numbers throughout, and its true attack surface is the fair attack of Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: Freedman 等人（2025年），脚注 1，通过将“生成一组候选答案并对每个答案应用我们的方法”的方式，将主张验证扩展到了多选项问题。这些候选答案就是问题本身的选项；ArgLLMs 为每个选项生成其论证树，且从不咨询外部委员会。 若向 ArgLLMs 输入委员会的提案者，其候选答案集反而会变为两个产物。 它会返回一个提案者段落作为答案（即上述解析问题），并导致 ArgLLMs 在 K > 2 的情况下看似可被攻击，因为对提案的篡改破坏了其候选答案集。 而忠实实现——即验证任务本身的选项——则恢复了 100% 的解析能力，并使 ArgLLMs 在所有 K 值下均不受委员会影响，这与它在二元情况下的表现完全一致。 其在 K > 2 情况下的准确率出现了双向变化：PubMedQA 从被低估的 0.369 提升至 0.516，而 MMLU 则从被高估的 0.682 下降至 0.565（此前它曾借助委员会提案中的信号）。 我们在全文中均报告了忠实实现的数值，其真正的攻击面则是附录 F 中描述的公平攻击。

paragraphs.en: An adversary instructed to maintain its wrong position every round complies by re-proposing —about 2.9 2.9 moves per task against the genuine members’ one—and under per-move counting that volume alone over-weights it (plurality falls to 0.29 0.29 ; per-agent BDA is inflated to 0.996 0.996 by a thrice-repeated inverted signal)—an artifact of move volume , not persuasion. The stealthy adversary of Appendix F deliberates naturally—one move per round, conceding to allies—which removes the artifact at the source: full-trace and one-vote-per-agent analyses agree. Volume effects are an easy way to fool oneself when evaluating a trace aggregator.
paragraphs.zh: 一个被指令在每一轮都维持错误立场的对手智能体，会通过重新提议来遵守该指令——每任务约 2.9 次移动，远低于真实成员的移动次数；而仅按每次移动的计数方式，这一数量本身就会使其权重过高（多数性降至 0.29；每个智能体的 BDA 因三次重复的倒置信号而被夸大至 0.996）——这是一种移动数量造成的假象，而非说服力的结果。 附录 F 中的隐蔽对手智能体以自然方式进行决策——每轮一次移动，并向盟友让步——这从根源上消除了上述假象：完整轨迹分析和每个智能体一票的分析结果一致。 在评估轨迹聚合器时，数量效应是一种容易误导自己的方法。

paragraphs.en: The label-permutation control of Appendix F.11 exposed a subtler artifact in our own baseline. Under the live k = 2 k{=}2 coalition, up to 22 % 22\% of the stacker’s PubMedQA predictions presented identical feature rows for two candidates (both un-endorsed once the genuine seat is flipped), so its top two scores tied exactly; a lexicographic tie-break by candidate string happens to correlate with the coalition’s wrong-answer choices, depressing the stacker there by about 0.11 0.11 . The seeded-random tie-break we use throughout removes the artifact ( → 0.75 0.643\!\to\!0.75 on live PubMedQA k = 2 k{=}2 ), shrinking the confusion-versus-stacking gap accordingly. The confusion model has zero exact ties on any live cell (its train-fitted candidate prior and asymmetric rows break every symmetry), and the one-coin’s exposure is bounded by its measured permutation invariance ( | Δ | ≤ 0.007 |\Delta|\leq 0.007 ). The general lesson: under an adversary that empties a candidate’s endorsement profile, argmax tie-breaking is part of the aggregator, and a deterministic rule can silently correlate with the attack.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 F.11 中的标签置换控制揭示了我们自身基线模型中一个更细微的伪影。 在实时 k = 2 的联盟下，堆叠器对 PubMedQA 预测中多达 22% 的结果，为两个候选项呈现了完全相同的特征行（一旦真实席位被翻转，两者均不再获得认可），因此其前两名得分恰好并列；而按候选项字符串进行的字典序决胜法恰好与联盟的错误答案选择相关，导致该堆叠器的得分下降了约 0.11。 我们在整个过程中使用的种子随机决胜法消除了这一伪影（在实时 PubMedQA k = 2 测试中，结果从 0.643 变为 0.75），从而相应地缩小了混淆与堆叠之间的差距。 混淆模型在任何实时单元格中都没有精确的并列情况（其训练拟合的候选项先验和不对称行打破了所有对称性），而单硬币暴露的上限由其测得的置换不变性决定（|Δ| ≤ 0.007）。 普遍的经验是：当对抗方清空某个候选项的认可记录时，argmax 并列决胜法已成为聚合器的一部分，而任何确定性规则都可能悄无声息地与攻击行为产生关联。

paragraphs.en: This section records the council configuration, the observed move inventory, the storage discipline, the drift guard, and the cost ledger, so the campaign can be reproduced or audited from the release.

paragraphs.en: The primary council is three heterogeneous chat models ( gemma-3-27b-it , phi-4 , gpt-4.1-nano ; fitted binary reliabilities 0.738 / 0.684 / 0.678 0.738/0.684/0.678 ). ArgLLMs’ evaluator and the MoA-family synthesizer run on gpt-4.1-mini . Three deliberation rounds, full visibility; round 0 0 is a Propose eliciting a JSON envelope (answer, reasoning, evidence, and a rubric-anchored confidence); rounds 1 1 and 2 2 emit one typed move each from { Propose , Concede , Challenge }, with admissibility enforced by a protocol automaton and agents anonymized as A 1 , A 2 , … A_{1},A_{2},\dots . Proposer temperature 0.7 0.7 ; three generation seeds. Every prompt is reproduced verbatim in Appendix I .

paragraphs.en: Traces and per-task results are cached append-only and keyed by council, dataset, condition, seed, and row. Every aggregator is a pure function of the cached trace, so all post-hoc comparisons run on identical inputs and each experiment is resumable after an interruption.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹和每个任务的結果以只追加的方式缓存，并以委员会、数据集、条件、种子和行作为键。 每个聚合器都是缓存轨迹的纯函数，因此所有事后比较都基于相同的输入运行，并且每次实验在中断后都可以恢复执行。

paragraphs.en: Every number in the paper and every figure derives from a single generated file, results_v5.json , produced by an export script that recomputes all cheaply-derivable entries from the stores; only the dose–response grid is embedded verbatim, with its provenance and regeneration command, because it needs about two CPU-hours. All figures are rendered exclusively from this file, so no number is typed into plotting code. An independent verifier re-derives a fast subset from the stores—majority accuracy and ECE on every clean and attacked cell, the stored baseline accuracies (including the canonically-dispatched ArgLLMs K > 2 K{>}2 cells and the judged MoA cells), the fair-attack cells on their shared rows, adversary compliance rates, fitted seat reliabilities, parse rates, the move inventory, and exact trace counts—and fails the build on any mismatch beyond 1.5 × 10 − 3 1.5\times 10^{-3} . The full chain (generation, stores, export, verify, figures, paper), with per-stage commands and costs, is documented in the released REPRODUCIBILITY.md .
paragraphs.zh: 论文中的每个数字和每张图表都源自一个单一的生成文件 results_v5.json，该文件由一个导出脚本创建，该脚本会重新计算所有可从存储数据中轻松推导出的条目；只有剂量-反应网格被原样嵌入，并附有其来源和再生命令，因为它的处理需要大约两个 CPU 小时。 所有图表都完全基于此文件生成，因此没有任何数字是手动输入到绘图代码中的。 一个独立的验证器会从存储数据中重新推导出一个快速子集——包括每个干净和受攻击单元格上的多数准确率与 ECE、存储的基线准确率（包括按标准方式调用的 ArgLLMs K > 2 K{>}2 单元格和已判定的 MoA 单元格）、其共享行上的公平攻击单元格、对手合规率、拟合座位可靠性、解析率、移动库存以及精确的轨迹计数——如果任何不匹配超过 1.5 × 10^{-3}，则构建过程会失败。 完整的流程（生成、存储、导出、验证、图表绘制和论文撰写），包括各阶段的命令与成本，均已记录在已发布的 REPRODUCIBILITY.md 文件中。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 repeats the main headline with the equal-mass binning added. The fairness comparison—given the same label budget, leak-free isotonic recalibration closes every method’s calibration error, after which the re-derivation baseline leads Brier and accuracy—is consolidated with the under-attack cells in Table 15 (Appendix F.9 ). BDA is therefore not the best clean aggregator that money can buy; its honest clean claims are the zero-added-cost calibration and the decision gain, which recalibration cannot produce.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 重复了主标题，并加入了等质量分箱。 公平性比较——在给定相同标签预算的情况下，无泄漏的等温重新校准消除了所有方法的校准误差，随后重新推导的基准方法优于 Brier 和准确率——这一结果与表 15（附录 F.9）中受攻击单元格的结果合并呈现。 因此，BDA 并非市面上最出色的纯净聚合器；其诚实的纯净特性是零附加成本的校准和决策增益，而这些是重新校准无法实现的。

The third, label efficiency, is main Figure 3 and Table 11 (Appendix E.6 ): about 25 25 labels buy the plateau for every supervised arm.

paragraphs.en: Under a leave-one-dataset-out protocol (fit reliabilities on two claim datasets, test on the third), per-agent beats majority on ECE and Brier on all three held-out datasets, and on accuracy on two of three (for example, TruthfulClaim 0.791 0.791 against 0.779 0.779 accuracy, 0.096 0.096 against 0.131 0.131 ECE): the reliability profile is a property of the agents, not of a dataset. Cross-domain transfer to PubMedQA preserves the calibration ordering but not the accuracy edge (Appendix E.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在“留一数据集”协议下（在两个理赔数据集上进行拟合可靠性评估，第三个数据集用于测试），在所有三个保留的数据集上，每个智能体在 ECE 和 Brier 指标上的表现均优于多数方法；在三个数据集中有两个数据集的准确率上也更优（例如，TruthfulClaim 的准确率为 0.791 0.791，而多数方法为 0.779 0.779；ECE 为 0.096 0.096，而多数方法为 0.131 0.131）：可靠性特征取决于智能体本身，而非数据集。 跨域迁移到 PubMedQA 保留了校准顺序，但未能保留准确率优势（附录 E.4）。

paragraphs.en: Truncating traces to at most round 0 0 , round 1 1 , or round 2 2 , with leak-free per-round refitting, leaves accuracy and calibration flat, as Table 8 shows. Deliberation changes the BDA decision on 353 353 of 4,500 4{,}500 binary tasks: 185 185 fixed, 168 168 broken, a net of 17 17 . Applying a full-trace-fitted prior to truncated traces would report a spurious threefold calibration gain from rounds; the leak-free per-round refit removes it.
paragraphs.zh: 将轨迹截断至最多第 0 轮、第 1 轮或第 2 轮，并采用每轮无泄漏的重拟合，则准确率和校准效果保持不变，如表 8 所示。 深思熟虑过程改变了 4,500 个二元任务中 353 个任务的 BDA 决策：其中 185 个结果固定不变，168 个结果被破坏，净变化为 17 个。 若将完整轨迹拟合的先验应用于截断后的轨迹，则会报告出一种源于各轮次的虚假三倍校准增益；而每轮的无泄漏重拟合则消除了这种增益。

paragraphs.en: The moves within a round are not conditionally independent: a concede is correlated with the move it targets, so treating every move as an independent draw over-counts the evidence. The tempered likelihood of main Eq. (4) raises each per-agent factor to a power τ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] \tau\in(0,1] , which down-weights that redundancy— τ \tau acts as an effective-sample-size control, with τ = 1 \tau{=}1 the fully independent model and small τ \tau discounting correlated moves toward a single effective vote. Here τ \tau is a first-class hyperparameter, selected jointly with the concentration λ \lambda by the same inner cross-validation on Brier. On binary tasks the over-counting is mild and the selection stays near τ ≈ 1 \tau{\approx}1 (re-cross-validating over τ ∈ { 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } \tau\in\{0.25,0.5,0.75,1\} there leaves the calibration error flat, 0.046 0.046 to 0.059 0.059 —the conjugate prior and the temperature are substitutable regularizers). For K > 2 K{>}2 , where a single seat emits several correlated moves over a larger answer space, the selection drives τ \tau well below one, and it is this tempering—not the confusion matrix alone—that flattens the multi-move over-concentration into the clean- K > 2 K{>}2 calibration fix reported in the main paper. Table 10 reports the selected ( λ , τ ) (\lambda,\tau) per cell.

paragraphs.en: Two questions a reader will ask of the clean results. Why ignore the members’ own stated confidence? The confidence-invariance property (§ C.6 ) makes the posterior invariant to it; empirically it should be ignored. Aggregating the council’s self-reported confidences—a confidence-weighted vote, reporting the winner’s mean stated confidence—gives ECE ew = 0.117 \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}}{=}0.117 , seven times BDA’s 0.016 0.016 (Table 6 ): the council is overconfident (it states about 0.83 0.83 on average but is right 0.73 0.73 ), and weighting the decision by that confidence does not help accuracy ( 0.732 0.732 , no better than plurality). Does the council beat its best member? Selecting the strongest seat leak-free (best round-0 accuracy on each training fold, evaluated held-out) gives accuracy 0.744 0.744 — above plurality’s 0.734 0.734 , so naive voting slightly under performs the best single model. BDA per-agent ( 0.751 0.751 ) is the only aggregator that matches or beats it, though the accuracy margin is a statistical tie ( Δ = + 0.006 \Delta{=}{+}0.006 , 95 % 95\% CI [ − 0.004 , + 0.016 ] [-0.004,+0.016] ); its edge is calibration ( ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 0.016 0.016 vs the best member’s 0.067 0.067 ) and cost ( $ 0 \$0 ). The clean-data value of BDA is thus a calibrated confidence the best model cannot give, at no added cost, without forfeiting the accuracy plurality loses.
paragraphs.zh: 读者会对这些干净的结果提出两个问题。 为何要忽略成员们自己声明的置信度？ 置信度不变性（§ C.6）使后验概率对此保持不变；从经验上看，应忽略该置信度。 汇总委员会的自我报告置信度——即进行置信度加权投票，并报告获胜者的平均声明置信度——得到 ECE ew = 0.117 \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}}{=}0.117，是 BDA 的 0.016 0.016 的七倍（表 6）：委员会存在过度自信的问题（其平均声明置信度约为 0.83 0.83，但正确率仅为 0.73 0.73），且用该置信度对决策进行加权并未提升准确性（0.732 0.732，与多数投票法相比并无改善）。 委员会的表现是否优于其最佳成员？ 选择最强的、无席位泄露的模型（在每个训练折上具有最佳第 0 轮准确率，通过预留数据评估）可获得 0.744 0.744 的准确率——高于多数投票法的 0.734 0.734，因此单纯的投票法表现略逊于最佳单一模型。 BDA 的每个智能体结果（0.751 0.751）是唯一能够匹配或超越该结果的聚合方法，尽管其准确率差异在统计上属于平局（Δ = + 0.006 \Delta{=}{+}0.006，95% 95\% 置信区间 [− 0.004 , + 0.016 ] [-0.004,+0.016]）；其优势在于校准性（ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 为 0.016 0.016，而最佳成员为 0.067 0.067）和成本（$ 0 \$0）。 因此，BDA 在干净数据上的价值在于：它提供了一种最佳模型无法给出的校准置信度，且无需额外成本，也不会牺牲多数投票法所失去的准确性。

paragraphs.en: The confusion model selects its Dirichlet concentration λ \lambda and temperature τ \tau jointly by the same inner cross-validation on Brier (Table 10 , left). On clean K > 2 K{>}2 it drives λ \lambda high —shrinking the learned confusion back toward the uniform-error one-coin—while τ \tau falls well below one. The control confirms the reading (Table 10 , right): a per-agent one-coin with a single cross-validated τ \tau and no learned off-diagonal already recovers the calibration ( ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} → 0.05 0.30\!\to\!0.05 on PubMedQA, → 0.04 0.18\!\to\!0.04 on MMLU), matching the full confusion model, at accuracy unchanged from the one-coin (tempering is argmax-preserving). The temperature is the clean- K > 2 K{>}2 calibration fix. Under the live k = 2 k{=}2 coalition the story inverts: the tempered one-coin cannot match the confusion’s accuracy ( 0.734 / 0.038 / 0.672 0.734/0.038/0.672 on binary/PubMedQA/MMLU against 0.892 / 0.840 / 0.721 0.892/0.840/0.721 ), because that gain is the learned matrix inverting a systematic coalition, and—being τ \tau -invariant—no temperature can produce it.
paragraphs.zh: 混淆模型通过相同的 Brier 内交叉验证（表 10，左侧）联合选择其狄利克雷浓度 λ \lambda 和温度 τ \tau。 在干净的 K > 2 K{>}2 条件下，该模型会将 λ \lambda 推高——使学习到的混淆矩阵回归到均匀误差的单硬币模型——而 τ \tau 则降至远低于 1。 对照实验证实了这一结果（表 10，右侧）：每个智能体采用单硬币模型，仅通过一次交叉验证确定 τ \tau，且没有学习到的非对角元素，即可恢复校准效果（在 PubMedQA 上 ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} → 0.05 0.30\!\to\!0.05，在 MMLU 上 → 0.04 0.18\!\to\!0.04），与完整的混淆模型效果一致，同时准确率与单硬币模型相比未发生变化（温度调整保留了 argmax 结果）。 温度是干净 K > 2 K{>}2 条件下实现校准的关键。 在动态 k = 2 k{=}2 联盟中，情况则相反：经过温度调整的单硬币模型无法达到混淆模型的准确率（在二元分类/PubMedQA/MMLU 上分别为 0.734 / 0.038 / 0.672 0.734/0.038/0.672，而混淆模型为 0.892 / 0.840 / 0.721 0.892/0.840/0.721），因为这一性能提升源于学习到的矩阵对系统性联盟的逆转，而由于该矩阵对 τ \tau 不变，任何温度都无法产生这种效果。

sents.en: The confusion model selects its Dirichlet concentration λ \lambda and temperature τ \tau jointly by the same inner cross-validation on Brier (Table 10 , left).
sents.zh: 混淆模型通过相同的 Brier 内交叉验证（表 10，左侧）联合选择其狄利克雷浓度 λ \lambda 和温度 τ \tau。

sents.en: On clean K > 2 K{>}2 it drives λ \lambda high —shrinking the learned confusion back toward the uniform-error one-coin—while τ \tau falls well below one.
sents.zh: 在干净的 K > 2 K{>}2 条件下，该模型会将 λ \lambda 推高——使学习到的混淆矩阵回归到均匀误差的单硬币模型——而 τ \tau 则降至远低于 1。

sents.en: The control confirms the reading (Table 10 , right): a per-agent one-coin with a single cross-validated τ \tau and no learned off-diagonal already recovers the calibration ( ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} → 0.05 0.30\!\to\!0.05 on PubMedQA, → 0.04 0.18\!\to\!0.04 on MMLU), matching the full confusion model, at accuracy unchanged from the one-coin (tempering is argmax-preserving).
sents.zh: 对照实验证实了这一结果（表 10，右侧）：每个智能体采用单硬币模型，仅通过一次交叉验证确定 τ \tau，且没有学习到的非对角元素，即可恢复校准效果（在 PubMedQA 上 ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} → 0.05 0.30\!\to\!0.05，在 MMLU 上 → 0.04 0.18\!\to\!0.04），与完整的混淆模型效果一致，同时准确率与单硬币模型相比未发生变化（温度调整保留了 argmax 结果）。

sents.en: The temperature is the clean- K > 2 K{>}2 calibration fix.
sents.zh: 温度是干净 K > 2 K{>}2 条件下实现校准的关键。

sents.en: Under the live k = 2 k{=}2 coalition the story inverts: the tempered one-coin cannot match the confusion’s accuracy ( 0.734 / 0.038 / 0.672 0.734/0.038/0.672 on binary/PubMedQA/MMLU against 0.892 / 0.840 / 0.721 0.892/0.840/0.721 ), because that gain is the learned matrix inverting a systematic coalition, and—being τ \tau -invariant—no temperature can produce it.

paragraphs.en: The confusion model carries K ⁡ ( K − 1 ) K(K{-}1) free off-diagonal parameters per seat against the one-coin’s one, so does “about 25 25 labels” still hold? On clean pools, yes, and for the stacker and gated vote too (Table 11 ): accuracy is flat from n = 10 n{=}10 at every K K (the one-coin-centered Dirichlet shrinkage does its job), and at n = 25 n{=}25 the confusion’s K > 2 K{>}2 calibration is already several times better than the one-coin ever gets ( ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 0.091 0.091 against 0.355 0.355 on PubMedQA), with MMLU settling by n ≈ 50 n{\approx}50 – 100 100 . The caveat is adversarial, not clean: under attack the off-diagonal must be estimated from attacked data , and the sleeper axis (Appendix F.8 ) already prices that—the confusion needs the turn in more of its window than the one-coin.
paragraphs.zh: 混淆模型每席位包含 K⁡(K−1)/K(K{-}1) 个自由的非对角参数，而单硬币模型仅有一个，因此“约 25 个标签”的结论是否仍然成立？ 在干净的数据集中，答案是肯定的，对于堆叠器和门控投票也是如此（表 11）：从 n = 10 n{=}10 开始，所有 K 值下准确率均保持不变（以单硬币为中心的狄利克雷收缩发挥了作用），而在 n = 25 n{=}25 时，混淆模型的 K > 2 K{>}2 校准效果已比单硬币模型好出数倍（在 PubMedQA 数据集上，EwECE \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 为 0.091 0.091，而单硬币模型仅为 0.355 0.355），MMLU 模型则在 n ≈ 50 n{\approx}50–100 100 时趋于稳定。 需要注意的是，这一结论适用于对抗性场景而非干净数据：在攻击条件下，非对角参数必须从受攻击的数据中估计，而潜在轴（附录 F.8）已对此进行了量化——混淆模型需要比单硬币模型占用更多窗口空间才能完成调整。

paragraphs.en: This section documents the adversary end to end: the conditions, the verbatim role prompts, the full synthetic grid, the calibration picture under the live attack, the invariance checks, and the fair attack in full.
paragraphs.zh: 本节全面记录了攻击方的全过程：包括相关条件、逐字呈现的角色提示、完整的合成网格、实时攻击下的校准图像、不变性检查以及完整的公平攻击。

paragraphs.en: Of the I = 3 I{=}3 seats, k ∈ { 1 , 2 } k\in\{1,2\} are adversarial. A persistent adversary occupies the same seats on every task, including the calibration folds; a rotating adversary corrupts freshly random seats per task. The synthetic (count-level) attack redirects a corrupted seat’s endorsement to a random wrong answer with probability p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} (full grid in Table 12 ). The live attack makes the adversarial seats real LLMs with a stealth role, on all five datasets and three seeds ( 13,800 13{,}800 traces).
paragraphs.zh: 在 I = 3 I{=}3 个席位中，有 k ∈ { 1 , 2 } k\in\{1,2\} 个是敌对席位。 持续存在的敌对智能体在所有任务中都占据相同的席位，包括校准折；轮替的敌对智能体则会在每个任务中破坏全新随机生成的席位。 合成（计数级）攻击以概率 p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} 将受破坏席位的推荐转向一个随机的错误答案（完整网格见表 12）。 实时攻击使敌对席位成为具有隐蔽角色的真实 LLM，覆盖全部五个数据集和三种种子（13,800 13{,}800 条轨迹）。

paragraphs.en: The two role prompts are reproduced verbatim—beside the honest prompts they piggyback on—in Appendix I ; each is prepended to the standard council prompt, so the adversary sees everything a genuine member sees.
paragraphs.zh: 两种角色提示词均原样重述——它们依附于诚实的提示词旁，后者见诸附录 I；每种角色提示词都置于标准委员会提示词之前，因此对手能看到真实成员所看到的一切。

paragraphs.en: Three design decisions, each forced by a measured failure. (i) Anti-answer, not fixed-wrong : forcing a specific wrong letter is ignored by the model on about 75 % 75\% of MMLU tasks (it argues its own preferred wrong instead); the anti-{correct} framing lets it choose a semantically defensible wrong, keeping answer and reasoning coherent. (ii) Coalition compatibility : two adversaries with different chosen wrongs still recognize each other as allies against {correct} and concede rather than fight. (iii) Natural volume : one move per round (Appendix D.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 三项设计决策，每一项都源于一次经过评估的失败。 (i) 反答案机制，而非固定错误：强制选择某个特定错误字母的做法在约 75% 的 MMLU 任务中会被模型忽略（模型反而会主张自己偏好的错误答案）；而采用反-{正确}的框架则能让模型选择一个语义上站得住脚的错误答案，从而保持答案与推理的一致性。 (ii) 联盟兼容性：两个选择了不同错误答案的对手仍会相互视为对抗-{正确}的盟友，并选择让步而非对抗。 (iii) 自然步数：每轮一步（附录 D.5）。

sents.en: Three design decisions, each forced by a measured failure.
sents.zh: 三项设计决策，每一项都源于一次经过评估的失败。

Targeting is strategic: on MMLU at k = 2 k{=}2 , adversaries challenged truth-supporting moves 56 56 times against 18 18 challenges of allies, and conceded to allies 34 34 times against 6 6 truth-concessions. On binary tasks adversaries occasionally get persuaded by a strong correct argument ( 8 8 to 13 % 13\% round- 0 0 non-compliance)—a realistic property we report rather than suppress.

paragraphs.en: This synthetic study isolates the count-level mechanism behind the live results: an adversary corrupts a fraction p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} of a seat’s informative moves (from p wrong = 0 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}0 , clean, to p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 , always wrong), and Table 12 reports accuracy on the binary pool across three regimes. Majority and shared BDA degrade monotonically as p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} rises—neither can single out the corrupted seat. Per-agent BDA is non-monotone : it dips when the adversary is only mildly unreliable (near chance, where the bad seat is least identifiable) and then rises as the adversary becomes reliably wrong, its fitted weight turning negative so its corrupted votes are inverted into evidence for the truth. The confusion model tracks it under the persistent coalition and ends higher at k = 2 k{=}2 ( 0.947 0.947 at p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 ). Rotation (bottom block) splits the two BDA parameterizations instructively. The per-agent one-coin falls monotonically—its prior map is centered on the council mean ( μ i = b + κ ⁡ ( r i − r ¯ ) \mu_{i}=b+\kappa(r_{i}-\bar{r}) ), and a rotating adversary depresses every seat equally, so the centering erases the signal. The confusion model fits absolute per-seat rows, and at high dose every seat’s row is genuinely anti-diagonal (each seat is corrupted on k / I k/I of tasks), so it inverts the whole council and recovers ( 0.554 0.554 at the p wrong = 0.4 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}0.4 valley, back to 0.811 0.811 at p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 ): rotation defeats per- seat identification, but a strong rotating coalition is still council-level identifiable. The honest unlearnable regime is moderate-dose rotation, where no trace-reading arm beats plurality.
paragraphs.zh: 这项合成研究分离出了实时结果背后的计数级机制：一个对抗者会破坏某个席位中信息性动作的 p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} 比例（从 p wrong = 0 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}0，即完全干净，到 p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1，即始终错误），表 12 报告了三种机制下二元池的准确率。 随着 p wrong p_{\mathrm{wrong}} 上升，多数投票和共享 BDA 的性能均单调下降——两者都无法识别出被破坏的席位。 每个智能体的 BDA 表现并非单调：当对抗者仅轻微不可靠时（接近随机水平，此时坏席位最难识别），其性能会下降；而当对抗者变得稳定错误时，性能又会上升，因为其拟合权重变为负值，从而将其被破坏的投票反转为支持真相的证据。 在持续联盟模型下，混淆模型能追踪这一趋势，并在 k = 2 k{=}2 时达到更高值（在 p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 时为 0.947 0.947）。 旋转机制（底部区块）对两种 BDA 参数化方式进行了富有启发性的区分。 每个智能体的单硬币模型性能单调下降——其先验映射以委员会均值为中心（μ i = b + κ ⁡ ( r i − r ¯ ) \mu_{i}=b+\kappa(r_{i}-\bar{r})），而旋转对抗者会同等程度地压制所有席位，因此这种中心化效应会消除信号。 混淆模型对每个席位的绝对行进行拟合，在高剂量下，每个席位的行都真正呈现反对角线特征（每个席位在 k / I k/I 比例的任务上被破坏），因此它反转了整个委员会，并在 p wrong = 0.4 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}0.4 的谷底恢复至 0.554 0.554，随后在 p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 时回升至 0.811 0.811：旋转机制破坏了单个席位的识别能力，但一个强大的旋转联盟在委员会层面仍然具有可识别性。 诚实且无法学习的机制对应中等剂量的旋转情况，此时没有任何痕迹读取臂能优于多数投票法。

sents.zh: 每个智能体的 BDA 表现并非单调：当对抗者仅轻微不可靠时（接近随机水平，此时坏席位最难识别），其性能会下降；而当对抗者变得稳定错误时，性能又会上升，因为其拟合权重变为负值，从而将其被破坏的投票反转为支持真相的证据。

sents.en: The confusion model tracks it under the persistent coalition and ends higher at k = 2 k{=}2 ( 0.947 0.947 at p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 ).
sents.zh: 在持续联盟模型下，混淆模型能追踪这一趋势，并在 k = 2 k{=}2 时达到更高值（在 p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 时为 0.947 0.947）。

sents.en: Rotation (bottom block) splits the two BDA parameterizations instructively.
sents.zh: 旋转机制（底部区块）对两种 BDA 参数化方式进行了富有启发性的区分。

sents.en: The per-agent one-coin falls monotonically—its prior map is centered on the council mean ( μ i = b + κ ⁡ ( r i − r ¯ ) \mu_{i}=b+\kappa(r_{i}-\bar{r}) ), and a rotating adversary depresses every seat equally, so the centering erases the signal.
sents.zh: 每个智能体的单硬币模型性能单调下降——其先验映射以委员会均值为中心（μ i = b + κ ⁡ ( r i − r ¯ ) \mu_{i}=b+\kappa(r_{i}-\bar{r})），而旋转对抗者会同等程度地压制所有席位，因此这种中心化效应会消除信号。

sents.en: The confusion model fits absolute per-seat rows, and at high dose every seat’s row is genuinely anti-diagonal (each seat is corrupted on k / I k/I of tasks), so it inverts the whole council and recovers ( 0.554 0.554 at the p wrong = 0.4 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}0.4 valley, back to 0.811 0.811 at p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 ): rotation defeats per- seat identification, but a strong rotating coalition is still council-level identifiable.
sents.zh: 混淆模型对每个席位的绝对行进行拟合，在高剂量下，每个席位的行都真正呈现反对角线特征（每个席位在 k / I k/I 比例的任务上被破坏），因此它反转了整个委员会，并在 p wrong = 0.4 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}0.4 的谷底恢复至 0.554 0.554，随后在 p wrong = 1 p_{\mathrm{wrong}}{=}1 时回升至 0.811 0.811：旋转机制破坏了单个席位的识别能力，但一个强大的旋转联盟在委员会层面仍然具有可识别性。

sents.en: The honest unlearnable regime is moderate-dose rotation, where no trace-reading arm beats plurality.
sents.zh: 诚实且无法学习的机制对应中等剂量的旋转情况，此时没有任何痕迹读取臂能优于多数投票法。

paragraphs.en: Does the deliberation itself contribute to robustness? For every attacked cell we truncate each trace to round 0 0 and re-run the identical pipeline with leak-free refitting on the truncated evidence (the truncation of Appendix E ’s rounds diagnostic, the same collapse basis); round- 0 0 one-coin is the classical supervised weighted vote of main Proposition 1, so Table 14 is the weighted-vote / full-trace / confusion comparison. The answer is unambiguous: round- 0 0 aggregation is more accurate under attack in eleven of twelve cells—the one-coin by up to 20 20 points (binary k = 2 k{=}2 ), the confusion by 3 3 to 13 13 —because rounds 1 1 – 2 2 are where contagion lives (Appendix F.14 ): the coalition’s challenges flip genuine seats, and reading those rounds imports the corrupted evidence. The live-attack defense is therefore carried by round- 0 0 reliability weighting; the typed trace earns its keep in the reliability estimator , the calibration, and the clean- K > 2 K{>}2 decision value (main Section 3), not in attacked-decision accuracy. Table 2 of the main paper compares aggregators on the full traces they would deploy on; this table decomposes where the robustness comes from.
paragraphs.zh: 审议过程本身是否有助于增强稳健性？ 对于每个受攻击的单元格，我们将每条痕迹截断至第 0 轮，并使用无泄漏的重拟合方法在截断后的证据上重新运行相同的流程（即附录 E 中各轮诊断的截断处理，采用相同的坍缩基础）；第 0 轮的“单硬币”模型即主命题 1 中的经典监督加权投票，因此表 14 展示了加权投票、完整痕迹与混淆矩阵之间的对比。 答案十分明确：在十二个单元格中，有十一个单元格显示第 0 轮的聚合方法在攻击下更为准确——“单硬币”模型最多可提升 20 个百分点（二元分类 k = 2），混淆矩阵的准确率则提升 3 至 13 个百分点——这是因为第 1 至第 2 轮正是传染效应存在的关键阶段（附录 F.14）：联盟的挑战会翻转真实席位，而读取这些轮次的结果则会引入被污染的证据。 因此，实时攻击防御依赖于第 0 轮的可靠性加权机制；带类型标注的痕迹在可靠性估计器、校准过程以及干净的 K > 2 决策值（主文第 3 节）中发挥关键作用，而非在受攻击决策的准确性方面。 主文中的表 2 比较了聚合器在其实际部署的完整痕迹上的表现；该表详细分析了稳健性的具体来源。
