paragraphs.en: Under the faithful multi-option dispatch, ArgLLMs verifies the task’s own options and never reads the trace, so its accuracy on the attacked store should equal its clean accuracy up to its own argument-sampling noise. It does: PubMedQA clean 0.516 0.516 against attacked 0.512 / 0.527 0.512/0.527 at k = 1 / k = 2 k{=}1/k{=}2 ; MMLU clean 0.565 0.565 against attacked 0.563 / 0.555 0.563/0.555 . The tiny differences are the generator’s temperature, present clean and attacked alike, not any influence of the adversary. Self-MoA on attacked traces is likewise unchanged. Both are invariant on every K K , as their code paths imply.
paragraphs.zh: 在忠实的多选项调度机制下，ArgLLMs 会验证任务本身的选项，且绝不会读取轨迹，因此其在受攻击存储上的准确率应与其正常情况下的准确率一致，最多仅存在自身参数采样带来的噪声差异。 事实确实如此：PubMedQA 在正常情况下的准确率为 0.516/0.516，而在受攻击情况下则为 0.512/0.527（k = 1）或 0.512/0.527（k = 2）；MMLU 在正常情况下的准确率为 0.565/0.565，而在受攻击情况下则为 0.563/0.555。 这些微小差异源于生成器的温度参数，该参数在正常和受攻击两种情况下均存在，与攻击方的任何影响无关。 对受攻击轨迹进行自我 MoA 分析的结果同样保持不变。 正如它们的代码路径所暗示的，这两种情况在所有 K 值下均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The design places the same anti-{correct} role inside each method’s own generation pipeline, at K = 2 , 3 , 4 K{=}2,3,4 over the full set of each dataset (five datasets, three seeds); main Figure 2 carries the result. For Self-MoA , the role preamble is prepended to the question its single proposer model samples six times (the synthesizer is untouched). For ArgLLMs , its argument generator is replaced by one instructed to make the verdict-flipping side compelling and the other a weak strawman, routed per candidate by gold (undermine the correct option, bolster the wrong ones), while its strength evaluator stays clean. Main Figure 2 gives the result. Self-MoA collapses on every dataset; ArgLLMs’ clean evaluator gives a partial defense, degrading by 24 24 to 28 28 points on every K K (staying above chance on binary, falling to or below it on the multi-option tasks); and BDA, facing the identical adversary as two of three council members, holds near its clean accuracy on all three. We evaluate at full n n (a fixed leading block is not representative: random 100 100 -row samples of BDA’s attacked accuracy are unbiased at 0.735 ± 0.04 0.735\pm 0.04 while the first 100 100 rows read 0.90 0.90 ); BDA’s and majority’s fair-attack cells are exactly their full- n n live-attack numbers (main Table 2). The architecture-level ordering—no internal check, then evaluator cross-check (weaker as K K grows), then redundancy with reliability learning—is the claim; at full corruption every method fails.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计将相同的反-{正确}角色置于每个方法自身的生成流程中，在 K = 2、3、4 时（K{=}2,3,4），针对每个数据集的全部样本集（五个数据集，三个种子）进行测试；主要结果见图 2。 对于 Self-MoA，角色前缀会被添加到问题之前，其唯一的提议模型会对此进行六次采样（合成器保持不变）。 对于 ArgLLMs，其论证生成器被替换为两个模型：一个被指令要求使判决翻转的立场更具说服力，另一个则是一个薄弱的稻草人论点；这两个模型根据黄金标准按候选项分别引导（削弱正确选项，强化错误选项），而其强度评估器则保持纯净。 主要结果见图 2。 Self-MoA 在所有数据集上均彻底失效；ArgLLMs 的纯净评估器提供了一定程度的部分防御，但在每个 K 值下，其得分从 24 分下降至 28 分（在二元任务中仍高于随机水平，而在多选项任务中则降至随机水平或更低）；而 BDA 尽管面临与三名委员会成员中两人相同的对抗者，在所有三个数据集上均保持了接近其纯净准确率的表现。 我们在完整的 n 上进行评估（固定的前导数据块不具备代表性：BDA 受攻击准确率的随机 100 行样本的无偏估计为 0.735 ± 0.04，而前 100 行的结果则为 0.90）；BDA 和多数派在公平攻击下的单元格数据完全等同于其完整 n 的实际攻击数据（见主表 2）。 该架构级别的顺序安排——先无内部检查，再进行评估器交叉验证（随着 K 增大而减弱），最后通过可靠性学习实现冗余——构成了这一方法的核心主张；但在完全受攻击的情况下，所有方法都会失败。

paragraphs.en: Per-agent BDA is supervised, so its sharpest threat is a sleeper : a seat clean throughout the labeled calibration window that turns hostile only at deployment inherits a positive weight and is trusted. We measure the exposure along the natural axis—the fraction f f of the calibration window in which the seat has already turned, i.e. how far a periodic re-fit has caught up with a seat that turned partway through (Figure 7 ). Deployment is the full persistent k = 2 k{=}2 coalition; the calibration set is a disjoint split in which each task carries the adversarial trace with probability f f and the clean trace otherwise, and we fit the reliabilities and hyperparameters on it and predict the held-out deployment. At f = 0 f{=}0 , the pure sleeper, per-agent BDA collapses to 0.17 0.17 — below majority’s 0.37 0.37 : it confidently follows the seats it learned to trust, and the confident weighting makes it worse than a plain vote. But the exposure window is narrow. Once the calibration captures 20 % 20\% of the adversary’s persistence the seat’s fitted reliability crosses the council mean, its vote weight flips negative, and accuracy jumps to 0.45 0.45 ; 30 % 30\% gives 0.56 0.56 , and the curve climbs to 0.63 0.63 by f = 0.4 f{=}0.4 , plateaus near 0.66 0.66 , and reaches the aware 0.72 0.72 at f = 1 f{=}1 . The assumption BDA needs is therefore not that the seat misbehaved throughout calibration but that the window is re-fit often enough to see it turn—and periodic re-fitting is the cheap mitigation, bounding the exposure to the interval before the next fit rather than the damage within it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体的 BDA 都受到监督，因此其最严峻的威胁是“潜伏型”智能体：在整个标注校准窗口期间表现正常，但在部署时才转为敌对状态的智能体，会继承正权重并受到信任。 我们沿着自然轴衡量暴露程度——即校准窗口中智能体已经转向的比例 f，也就是说，周期性重新拟合在多大程度上追上了中途转向的智能体（图 7）。 部署阶段是完整的持久性 k = 2 的联盟；校准集则是一个不相交的划分，其中每个任务以概率 f 携带对抗性痕迹，否则携带正常痕迹。我们基于此拟合可靠性和超参数，并对预留的部署数据进行预测。 当 f = 0 时，纯潜伏型智能体对应的每个智能体 BDA 会降至 0.17——低于多数派的 0.37：它会自信地跟随已学会信任的智能体，而这种自信的权重分配使其表现甚至不如简单的投票。 但暴露窗口非常狭窄。 一旦校准过程捕捉到对抗性智能体持续性的 20%，该智能体的拟合可靠性就会超过委员会的平均值，其投票权重会转为负值，准确率则跃升至 0.45；30% 时准确率达到 0.56，曲线在 f = 0.4 时攀升至 0.63，随后在 0.66 附近趋于平缓，并在 f = 1 时达到具备感知能力的 0.72。 因此，BDA 所需的假设并非智能体在整个校准期间都表现异常，而是校准窗口需要足够频繁地重新拟合以捕捉到其转向的过程——而周期性重新拟合正是这种低成本缓解措施，它将暴露范围限制在下次拟合之前的区间内，而非区间内的实际损害。

paragraphs.en: The same axis, swept per arm (Figure 7 ), exhibits the bias–variance trade-off that the Dirichlet washout of Appendix C.5 predicts. At light contamination the fewer-parameter one-coin recovers fastest ( 0.45 0.45 at f = 0.2 f{=}0.2 against the confusion model’s 0.26 0.26 ): the adversary’s off-diagonal is under-determined there, and the concentration prior dominates. Once the turn is well inside the window the ordering inverts—the confusion model overtakes from f ≈ 0.6 f{\approx}0.6 and reaches 0.90 0.90 at f = 1 f{=}1 (against the one-coin’s 0.72 0.72 ), the learned matrix converting the fully-observed coalition into the inverted-oracle gain of the live attack. The stacker tracks the one-coin early and the confusion late; the gated vote is a step function (a seat is either ejected or not), flat at 0.20 0.20 until the gate trips near f = 0.5 f{=}0.5 . Cross-validation inside the contaminated window cannot see the deployment shift, so no arm dominates the whole axis: the trade-off is intrinsic.
paragraphs.zh: 沿每条臂扫过的同一轴（图7）展示了附录C.5中Dirichlet洗出所预测的偏差-方差权衡。 在轻度污染情况下，参数较少的单硬币模型恢复最快（f = 0.2时达到0.45，而混淆模型仅为0.26）：此时对抗方的非对角元素处于欠确定状态，且集中先验占据主导地位。 一旦转向完全进入窗口范围，排序就会反转——混淆模型从f ≈ 0.6开始超越单硬币模型，并在f = 1时达到0.90（而单硬币模型仅为0.72），此时学习到的矩阵将完全观测到的联盟转化为实时攻击中的反向神谕增益。 堆叠器在早期阶段跟踪单硬币模型，而在后期阶段则跟踪混淆模型；门控投票是一个阶跃函数（席位要么被驱逐，要么未被驱逐），在f = 0.5附近触发门控之前始终保持0.20不变。 污染窗口内的交叉验证无法检测到部署变化，因此没有哪个臂能在整个轴上占据主导地位：这种权衡是内在的。

paragraphs.en: Given the same 25 25 -label budget, leak-free 5 5 -fold isotonic recalibration ( Zadrozny and Elkan 2002 ) is applied to every confidence-emitting arm (Table 15 ). On clean data it collapses everyone’s calibration error to a common floor—a recalibrated majority reaches ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 0.006 0.006 on binary, erasing BDA’s edge. It cannot recalibrate accuracy : under the persistent coalition a recalibrated majority is perfectly calibrated at ECE ew ≈ 0 \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}}\!\approx\!0 but only 0.37 0.37 / 0.21 0.21 / 0.43 0.43 accurate, while BDA confusion holds 0.89 0.89 / 0.84 0.84 / 0.72 0.72 . This is why we do not headline clean calibration: BDA’s durable advantages are accuracy under attack and zero cost.

sents.zh: 标签切换结果所利用的翻转对称性仅在 K = 2 K{=}2 时严格成立（命题 3 在 K > 2 K{>}2 时使其失效）；MMLU 中 k = 2 k{=}2 时结果坍缩至 0.001 0.001，是模式捕捉失败的一个相关但独立的现象——EM 的决策在 1,500 1{,}500 个任务中与一个对抗性联盟的投票结果一致（即它几乎完全收敛于该联盟的共识标签）。

paragraphs.en: Why does the confusion model lead on PubMedQA while the stacker leads on MMLU? The candidate hypothesis is label stability : PubMedQA’s yes/no/maybe mean the same thing on every task, so a confusion row over candidates is a meaningful cross-task object; MMLU’s A–D are arbitrary per-task positions, so there is little stable structure to fit. The test is a per-task random relabeling of the candidate space (Table 17 ): it destroys cross-task label identity while preserving every within-task relationship, so arms whose statistics never compare labels across tasks must be invariant. They are: the one-coin and the stacker move by at most 0.007 0.007 anywhere (the stacker only after the tie-break fix of Appendix D.6 , which this control exposed). The confusion model splits exactly along the hypothesis: on live PubMedQA k = 2 k{=}2 permutation costs it 0.100 0.100 —its entire margin over the stacker, which is therefore a label-identity effect—while its remaining + 0.26 +0.26 over the one-coin survives, i.e. the robustness gain is label-invariant per-seat error structure, not label memorization. On MMLU permutation changes nothing ( − 0.005 -0.005 ): there was no label-stable structure to destroy, which is precisely why the discriminative stacker, indifferent to candidate identity, wins there.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么混淆模型在 PubMedQA 上表现领先，而堆叠模型则在 MMLU 上领先？ 候选假设是标签稳定性：PubMedQA 的“是/否/也许”在每个任务中含义相同，因此候选项之间的混淆行是一个有意义的跨任务对象；而 MMLU 的 A–D 在每个任务中的位置都是任意的，因此几乎没有稳定的结构可供拟合。 测试方法是对每个任务的候选空间进行随机重新标记（表 17）：这会破坏跨任务的标签同一性，同时保留每个任务内部的所有关系，因此那些统计量从未跨任务比较标签的模型必须保持不变。 它们分别是：单硬币模型和堆叠模型的移动幅度在任何地方最多不超过 0.007（堆叠模型仅在附录 D.6 的平局处理修正之后才会发生移动，而本次对照实验揭示了这一点）。 混淆模型恰好沿着该假设进行拆分：在真实的 PubMedQA 数据中，当 k = 2 时，其排列成本为 0.100——这完全超过了堆叠模型的差距，因此这是一个标签同一性效应；而它相对于单硬币模型剩余的 +0.26 的优势仍然存在，也就是说，这种鲁棒性提升是每席位误差结构中不变的，而非对标签的记忆。 在 MMLU 中，排列变化并未带来任何改变（−0.005）：因为原本就没有稳定的标签结构可供破坏，而这正是判别性堆叠模型能够获胜的原因——它对候选项的同一性并不敏感。

paragraphs.en: The one-coin needs only “the seat stays below chance” to persist from calibration to deployment; the confusion model needs the structure of the errors—which wrong answers the seat favors—to persist. The sleeper axis covers temporal onset; this experiment covers the policy shift. Two cached wrong-selection policies over the same K > 2 K{>}2 tasks at k = 2 k{=}2 : policy A corrupts seats toward a uniformly random wrong answer (the synthetic adversary), and policy B is the live coalition’s best-defensible wrong answer. We calibrate on half the rows under one policy and deploy on the disjoint half under the other, against matched within-policy controls (Table 18 ). The verdict is the predicted asymmetry, with one refinement the table forced on us: within-policy, the confusion holds its live edge ( 0.842 0.842 on PubMedQA B → \to B); across policies it loses the entire edge and collapses to the one-coin’s level or below ( 0.528 0.528 – 0.578 0.578 shifted). The stacker is not the policy-invariant alternative one might hope for: its count-profile mapping is policy-specific too, shedding 0.08 0.08 – 0.15 0.15 on PubMedQA and collapsing outright on MMLU B → \to A ( 0.319 0.319 , the worst cell of any arm). Only the one-coin is policy-robust across every shifted cell ( 0.531 0.531 – 0.708 0.708 ), because its sufficient statistic—total consistency with gold—does not care which wrong answers a seat favors. Structure stationarity is therefore a real, measured assumption of both learned-structure arms, and the one-coin is the unique safe fallback between re-fits.
paragraphs.zh: 单硬币模型只需“座位偏好低于随机水平”这一条件，就能从校准阶段延续到部署阶段；而混淆模型则需要错误结构——即座位偏好哪些错误答案——能够持续存在。 睡眠轴涵盖时间上的起始点；本实验则涵盖策略转变。 在 k = 2 时，针对相同的 K > 2 K{>}2 个任务，存在两种缓存的错误选择策略：策略 A 会将座位偏好向均匀随机的错误答案（合成对抗者）扭曲，而策略 B 则是实时联盟中最具辩护性的错误答案。 我们在一种策略下对一半的行数据进行校准，并在另一种策略下的互斥另一半数据上进行部署，同时与同策略内的对照实验进行对比（表 18）。 最终结论是预测出的不对称性，但表格还强制揭示了一个细节：在同策略内，混淆模型仍保持其实时优势（PubMedQA B → \to B 上的 0.842）；而在跨策略比较中，它完全失去了这一优势，并跌至单硬币模型的水平或更低（0.528 – 0.578 的偏移值）。 堆叠器并非人们所期望的策略无关替代方案：其计数-分布映射同样依赖具体策略，在 PubMedQA 上损失了 0.08 – 0.15，并在 MMLU B → \to A 上完全失效（0.319，所有分支中最差的单元格）。 只有单硬币模型在所有偏移单元格中都表现出策略鲁棒性（0.531 – 0.708），因为其充分统计量——与黄金答案的总体一致性——并不关心座位偏好哪些错误答案。 因此，结构平稳性是两种学习结构模型共同依赖的一个真实且可测量的假设，而单硬币模型则是在重新拟合之间唯一安全的备用方案。

paragraphs.en: The deployment recommendation leans on an alarm—“exposures announce themselves as drift in the fitted rows”—which we now measure rather than assert. The statistic is the mean per-(seat, class) total variation between confusion rows fitted (fixed λ = 10 \lambda{=}10 , so drift is not confounded with hyperparameter selection) on two labeled windows; its noise floor is the same statistic between two disjoint clean half-windows (conservative: half-size windows overstate sampling noise). Along the sleeper axis the drift is monotone in the contaminated fraction f f — 0.036 0.036 , 0.074 0.074 , 0.105 0.105 , up to 0.358 0.358 at f = 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.3 , … , 1 f{=}0.1,0.2,0.3,\dots,1 —against a floor of 0.033 0.033 : a refit window carrying a fifth of the turn already raises the alarm at more than twice the floor, at exactly the exposure where the confusion cannot yet exploit the data (deployment accuracy 0.26 0.26 at f = 0.2 f{=}0.2 , Figure 7 ). The alarm precedes the recovery, which is what makes “fall back to the one-coin and re-fit” actionable. Across the policy boundary the single-refit drift is 0.202 0.202 (PubMedQA) and 0.193 0.193 (MMLU) against floors of 0.068 0.068 and 0.110 0.110 —detected at the first labeled refit. One caveat is honest: at f = 0.1 f{=}0.1 the drift ( 0.036 0.036 ) sits at the floor, so a turn occupying less than roughly a tenth of the window can hide; the exposure of Appendix F.8 is bounded by refit frequency, not eliminated.
paragraphs.zh: 部署建议依赖一项警报——“暴露表现为拟合行中的漂移”——而我们现在能够测量这一警报，而非仅凭断言。 该统计量是（每座、每班）混淆行拟合（固定 λ = 10 \lambda{=}10，因此漂移不会与超参数选择产生混淆）在两个带标签窗口上的总变异的平均值；其噪声基线则是两个不相交的干净半窗口间相同的统计量（保守估计：使用半尺寸窗口会高估采样噪声）。 沿睡眠轴方向，漂移在污染比例 f 中呈单调变化——0.036、0.074、0.105，直至 f = 0.1、0.2、0.3、…、1 时达到 0.358——而基线为 0.033：一个包含十分之一转向量的重新拟合窗口，其警报值已超过基线的两倍，恰好处于混淆尚无法利用数据的暴露水平（f = 0.2 时部署准确率为 0.26，见图 7）。 警报先于恢复出现，这正是“回退到单硬币模型并重新拟合”具有可行性的原因。 跨越策略边界时，单次重新拟合的漂移为 0.202（PubMedQA）和 0.193（MMLU），而基线分别为 0.068 和 0.110——该漂移在首次带标签的重新拟合中即被检测到。 有一个坦诚的警告：当 f = 0.1 时，漂移（0.036）处于基线水平，因此一个占据窗口约十分之一以下的转向量可能被隐藏；附录 F.8 中的暴露受重新拟合频率的限制，但并未被消除。

paragraphs.en: Near-chance seat. The dose–response dip regime finally gets a live instance: swapping in llama-3.2-1b (schema-probed 16 / 16 16/16 ; its committed round- 0 0 accuracy on this family is ≈ 0.43 {\approx}0.43 ) lands the fitted move-level reliability at 0.553 0.553 —squarely near-chance. No dip materializes: every BDA arm beats plurality (confusion 0.724 0.724 , per-agent 0.705 0.705 , shared 0.691 0.691 , against majority 0.684 0.684 ; stacking 0.719 0.719 ), the confusion takes the best Brier ( 0.188 0.188 ) and the shared/per-agent priors stay calibrated ( ECE ew \mathrm{ECE}_{\mathrm{ew}} 0.016 0.016 / 0.028 0.028 ). The dose–response dip is therefore a property of a partially adversarial seat at weak dose—sometimes misleading, hardest to identify—not of an honestly mediocre one, which is merely uninformative and is shrunk toward a zero weight. Cost of the live check: $4.39, metered.

paragraphs.en: The verdicts diverge exactly as the mechanism predicts. Plain majority voting is swayed to False —the coalition’s proposals, plus the genuine seat’s round-1 flip, out-count the truth—and is scored wrong ; BDA per-agent returns True at 0.89 0.89 , because the seats it has learned to distrust are the ones arguing False , and a distrusted rejection is evidence for the other answer. Here the inversion carries most of the decision ( 67 % 67\% of the winning log-odds): even when contagion turns the genuine seat, a reliability-weighted reading recovers the truth. Were every seat instead to argue False consistently for three rounds, the log-odds would grow without bound and the posterior would saturate toward 1.00 1.00 —the honest K = 2 K{=}2 over-concentration under strong evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 判决结果与机制的预测完全一致。 简单多数投票被影响而得出“假”——联盟的提案加上真实席位在第一轮的翻转，其计票结果超过了真相——因此被判错误；BDA 每个智能体的结果则返回“真”，数值为 0.89 0.89，因为它学会不信任的席位正是那些主张“假”的席位，而不被信任的拒绝反而成为支持另一种答案的证据。 在这里，反转决定了大部分结果（获胜对数赔率的 67% 67\%）：即使传染效应改变了真实席位的立场，经过可靠性加权的解读仍能恢复真相。 如果每个席位改为在三轮中始终主张“假”，那么对数赔率将无限增长，后验概率将饱和至 1.00 1.00——这正是强证据下诚实的 K = 2 K{=}2 过度集中现象。

paragraphs.en: Contagion is real but not universal: elsewhere in the corpus a genuine member re-proposes the gold answer with fresh reasoning every round and BDA returns it while majority still falls—and some flips are honest difficulty rather than persuasion—the decomposition Hao and others (2026) make systematic—so we do not attribute every council error to the adversary.
paragraphs.zh: 传染性是真实存在的，但并非普遍现象：在语料库的其他部分，一位真正的成员每一轮都会用全新的推理重新提出黄金答案，而 BDA 也会将其返回，尽管多数意见仍然落败——某些观点的翻转源于真实的困难，而非说服——Hao 等人（2026）对此进行了系统性分解——因此，我们不会将每一次委员会的错误都归因于对手。

paragraphs.en: Can the same construction make a council of small models trustworthy? We rerun generation with three sub-8B open-weight models of distinct lineages— llama-3.1-8b-instruct , qwen-2.5-7b-instruct , and the sparse mixture-of-experts lfm-2-24b-a2b (about 2B active parameters)—and apply BDA unchanged. The calibration transfer is complete and the heterogeneity boundary is clean; the full table, the fitted reliabilities, and the model pre-flight are here.
paragraphs.zh: 同样的构建方式能否让小型模型组成的委员会值得信赖？ 我们使用三个不同谱系的子8B开放权重模型重新运行生成过程——llama-3.1-8b-instruct、qwen-2.5-7b-instruct，以及稀疏专家混合模型 lfm-2-24b-a2b（约20亿活跃参数）——并沿用未修改的BDA方法。 校准转移已完成，异质性边界清晰明确；完整表格、拟合可靠性以及模型预飞行检查结果均在此处。

paragraphs.en: Two of three originally planned small models could not produce the typed-move schema at all (one emits off-schema JSON, one routes into tool-calls and returns empty content)—discovered by a probe costing under one cent before any spend. The final council (an 8B model, a 7B model, and a sparse MoE with about 2B active parameters, of three lineages) passes the schema probe on binary and K > 2 K{>}2 envelopes. We report this because schema reliability, not raw capability, was the binding constraint on small-council membership.
paragraphs.zh: 最初计划的小型模型中，有两个完全无法生成打字移动方案（其中一个输出不符合方案的 JSON，另一个则转向工具调用并返回空内容）——这一情况在尚未产生任何费用前，通过一次不到一美分的探测便已发现。 最终委员会（由一个 8B 模型、一个 7B 模型以及一个拥有约 20 亿个活跃参数的稀疏 MoE 组成，共三个谱系）通过了针对二进制和 K > 2 K{>}2 信封的方案探测。 我们报告此事，是因为方案可靠性而非原始能力，才是小型委员会成员资格的关键限制因素。

paragraphs.en: Every seat receives the evidence-eliciting JSON envelope with an anchored confidence rubric; an adversarial seat gets the role prepended—argue against the correct answer by choosing the most defensible wrong one (anti-answer, not fixed-wrong; Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个座位都会收到一个包含锚定置信度评分标准的证据提取 JSON 信封；对抗性座位则会额外获得一个角色设定——通过选择最具辩护性的错误答案（反答案，而非固定错误答案；附录 F）来反驳正确答案。

paragraphs.en: Each seat picks one typed move ( Concede , Challenge , Propose ) as a JSON object, prior moves summarized newest-last; the stealth role challenges any defense of the correct answer, concedes to allies, blends in, and varies its reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 每个席位都选择一个类型的行动（认输、挑战、提议）作为 JSON 对象，此前的行动按最新到最早顺序汇总；隐形角色会挑战对正确答案的任何防御，向盟友认输，融入其中，并改变其推理方式。

paragraphs.en: ArgLLMs’ two components follow Freedman and others (2025) , Appendix A: the argument generator Γ \Gamma and the intrinsic-strength evaluator ℰ \mathcal{E} . The MoA aggregator prompt is Wang and others (2025) , Table 1, verbatim (Self-MoA uses the identical template). The frozen scoring judge of Appendix D.3 maps a prose-only free-text answer to a committed option.
paragraphs.zh: ArgLLMs 的两个组件遵循 Freedman 等人（2025）的研究，见附录 A：论证生成器 Γ \Gamma 和内在强度评估器 ℰ \mathcal{E}。 MoA 聚合提示词完全采用 Wang 等人（2025）表 1 中的内容（Self-MoA 使用相同的模板）。 附录 D.3 中的固定评分裁判将纯文本的自由回答映射到一个确定的选项。

paragraphs.en: Table 22 separates what we adopt from prior work from what is new here, so a reader can see the contribution at a glance. In the “our role” column, “baseline” means a method we reimplement and compare against; “building block” means a standard result we use; “evaluation target” means a metric we report.
paragraphs.zh: 表 22 区分了我们在先有研究中所采用的内容与本文的新贡献，因此读者可以一目了然地看到我们的贡献。 在“我们的角色”列中，“基线”指我们重新实现并用于比较的方法；“构建模块”指我们使用的标准结果；“评估目标”指我们报告的指标。
